advancements.theoreticalsciences.frontie: Ride starlight to the Accretion Frontier.
advancements.theoreticalsciences.interio: Drill through the floor of the world into the Planetary Interior.
block.theoreticalsciences.abiogenesis_cr: A crucible of primordial soup under lightning and ultraviolet light, held where chemistry tips over into life.
block.theoreticalsciences.absolute_frame: A frame that keeps its shape whatever the laws around it do: the one fixed reference in a place where every other measure has come loose.
block.theoreticalsciences.absolute_pedes: A pedestal of the highest grade, made to hold an offering at the very centre of a ritual. Nothing set on it is ever quite where it was before.
block.theoreticalsciences.acceleration_c: A copper RF cavity ringing at its resonant frequency. Its field points forward each time a bunch arrives, so particles gain energy on every pass.
block.theoreticalsciences.accretion_casi: Casing built to sit beside an accretion disk, where infalling gas heats to millions of degrees and shines in X-rays before it crosses the horizon.
block.theoreticalsciences.accretion_disk: Accretion Disk Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Feeds matter onto a captive black hole: falling in, it gives up to a third of its rest energy as light. Too much at once, and its own light blows the disk away.
block.theoreticalsciences.accretion_frag: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Accretion Disk Fragment when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.aerosol_spraye: Breaks liquid into droplets fine enough to hang in the air for days. The same kind of haze turns Titan orange and hides its surface from view.
block.theoreticalsciences.aleph_glass.lo: Glass whose clarity has a cardinality. It holds countably many points of light in a perfectly ordered grid, yet every sliver of it still contains as many points as the whole.
block.theoreticalsciences.alt_az_mount.l: A mount that turns a dish on two simple axes, altitude and azimuth, while a computer works out how to follow the sky. Nearly every large modern telescope sits on one.
block.theoreticalsciences.analog_black_h: A condensate flowing faster than its own speed of sound: a horizon that sound cannot cross back over - and, at it, Hawking radiation of phonons.
block.theoreticalsciences.analytic_conti: Calculus in a box: limits, derivatives, integrals, series and the analytic continuation of functions into the complex plane.
block.theoreticalsciences.annihilation_r: Converts mass entirely into energy, E = mc^2, regulated by dilithium crystals.
block.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_contai: A quarantine cell of chronoplastic walls, causal shielding and windows of containment glass, with dimensional stabilisers at every corner. It lets what it holds grow - just slower than its field can clear it.
block.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_resolu: A tower of reality-lattice casing around a column of lensed, error-corrected fields. It doses an anomaly fraction by fraction until not one of its cells is left, and writes what it learned back into the laws.
block.theoreticalsciences.answer_pedesta: A plinth that waits for a conclusion. When the right answer is placed on it, the surrounding proof settles into consistency and the room grows quiet. A wrong answer sits there and does nothing at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.anticarbon_ore: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -60 and 20. Gives Anticarbon Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antigold_ore.l: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -48 and 60. Gives Raw Anti-Gold when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_i: Found in the Antiverse, between Y 20 and 160. Gives Antihydrogen Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiiron_ore.l: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -48 and 120. Gives Raw Anti-Iron when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_pen: Pair-produces antimatter from gamma photons and holds it in a magnetic bottle.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiproton_dec: A ring that catches antiprotons from collisions at nearly light speed and brakes them, lap after lap, until they can be trapped.
block.theoreticalsciences.antisilicon_or: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -20 and 100. Gives Antisilicon Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antisoil.lore: Soil of the Antiverse, made of antiprotons, antineutrons and positrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.antistone.lore: Stone made of antimatter, the mirror image of ordinary rock. It looks exactly the same; only meeting matter would tell the difference, and then not for long.
block.theoreticalsciences.antistone_bric: Antistone dressed into bricks. Among antimatter it is as sound as any masonry; a single ordinary atom touching it would annihilate with it.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiverse_cach: A locker for matter of the wrong sign. It holds its contents by fields alone, since a single touch of the walls would annihilate both.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiwater.lore: Antiwater, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.aquifer_pump.l: Draws water from the rock it stands on - and, in the Planetary Interior, brine and hotter things.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_heartwoo: The innermost wood of the Arbor, dense and pale, with rings that record not years but the branching of possibilities. Run a finger along the grain and it follows a different branch each time.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_planks.l: Planks cut from the Arbor, pale and fine-grained, with faint branching lines running along their length. The wood smells of rain and seems to grow warmer when people walk across it.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_planks_s: A slab of Arbor Planks, for building with.
Stairs of Arbor Planks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.armature_breec: The loading end of a railgun, where the conducting armature sits across the rails. A megaamp pulse closes the circuit and the Lorentz force flings it down the bore.
The rubble of planetesimals that never became planets. Its chondrules are frozen droplets from the Solar System's first few million years.
block.theoreticalsciences.atomic_clock.l: Counts the oscillations of a caesium atom. The deeper it stands in a gravity well, the slower it ticks.
block.theoreticalsciences.autocatalytic_: Autocatalytic Broth, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.autonomous_ext: An Extreme Assembly Table that crafts on its own: give it a pattern, feed it, power it.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_distille: Boils reality down past its source code to the axioms underneath, and condenses them into fragments.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_lamp.lor: A lamp that shines when its axiom is in force. Its light is steady and colourless, and when the axiom is withdrawn it simply goes dark. Rows of them read like a truth table drawn in light.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_stone.lo: Pale, smooth stone that seems to be made of definitions. Each block holds its shape because it has been told to. It is cool and faintly humming, like a theorem being proved.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_toggle.l: A switch that adopts or rejects an axiom. Flip it and the local truths rearrange; some things become provable, others not.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiomatic_brea: Breaks every law of physics and mathematics at once. While it runs, step into its heart to fall out of reality.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiomatic_fiel: A field emitter that projects not forces but rules - a small region where a chosen axiom holds or does not.
Lava that cooled slowly and shrank as it set, cracking into columns, most often six-sided, as at the Giant's Causeway.
block.theoreticalsciences.basaltic_magma: Basaltic Magma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.bayesian_analy: Weighs a prior against a piece of evidence and writes down the updated belief.
block.theoreticalsciences.bec_trap.lore: A magnetic bottle for atoms cooled to billionths of a degree, where thousands of them fall into one quantum state and move as a single wave.
block.theoreticalsciences.bending_magnet: A dipole magnet that curves a beam of charged particles along an arc. The faster the beam or the tighter the turn, the stronger the field it needs.
block.theoreticalsciences.bioreactor.lor: A sterile, stirred, temperature-held vat where cells grow and do the chemistry for you.
block.theoreticalsciences.bitter_plate_s: Perforated copper discs stacked in a helix, as Francis Bitter designed in the 1930s. Water rushes through the holes to carry off the heat of tens of kiloamps.
block.theoreticalsciences.bose_einstein_: Bose-Einstein Condensate, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Cools atoms to nanokelvin until they share a single quantum state.
block.theoreticalsciences.breached_anoma: Ruins of a machine that pulled creatures out of nothing. Built anew at the Convergence Altar, it grows any creature whose genome it is shown.
block.theoreticalsciences.bridgmanite_or: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 4 and 70. Gives Bridgmanite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.brown_dwarf_or: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Brown Dwarf Core when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.brownian_micro: A microscope over a drop of water with clay in it. The grains never stop jittering - molecules strike them from every side - and how far they wander weighs the molecules.
block.theoreticalsciences.brownian_suspe: Brownian Suspension, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.bubble_pedesta: The cradle on which a warp bubble is shaped. In Alcubierre's metric space contracts ahead and expands behind, while the bubble's own interior stays flat and calm.
block.theoreticalsciences.bubble_univers: A sphere of an entirely separate universe, nucleated out of the inflating vacuum and sealed off from ours. Inside it, the constants are slightly different.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_cache.lor: Bigger on the inside: it borrows a little room from a fifth dimension. In brane cosmology our whole universe floats in such a bulk.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_crystal.l: A translucent crystal from the Bulk whose facets seem to point in directions I cannot quite name.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_stone.lor: The bedrock of the higher-dimensional Bulk: a grey stone that seems to have more surfaces than it shows. Edges blur where the extra dimensions curl back in.
block.theoreticalsciences.burst_casing.l: The shell of an observatory that waits for bursts lasting milliseconds that never repeat. It is built to sit very still for a very long time.
block.theoreticalsciences.burst_observat: Twelve scintillators facing every way at once, waiting for the brightest explosions in the Universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.calorimeter_de: An array of scintillator crystals and pixel trackers that records where a particle went and how much energy it carried. A quantum processor reads the flashes. The crystals glow faintly when hit.
block.theoreticalsciences.cantor_diagona: Lists every number, then builds one that is on no list. Manufactures infinities - and then bigger ones.
block.theoreticalsciences.capacitor_bank: Rows of capacitors charged slowly and emptied all at once: energy gathered over seconds, released in microseconds as a single heavy pulse.
block.theoreticalsciences.carborane_supe: Carborane Superacid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.cardinal_ore.l: Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Cardinal Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.cascade_casing: Shielded housing for a centrifuge cascade. Each stage enriches uranium only slightly, so stages are piped in series by the dozen and machines run by the thousand.
block.theoreticalsciences.casimir_energy: An energy store built around the force between two plates in a vacuum.
Presses matter between plates so close the vacuum itself pushes back.
block.theoreticalsciences.causal_shieldi: A plate of chronosteel and causal shield lattice that keeps cause and effect in the right order on either side. It feels slightly ahead of the moment, as though it knew I was going to touch it.
Causal Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.causality_loop: Sends objects back along a closed timelike curve so they exist twice. The universe is not amused.
block.theoreticalsciences.central_soleno: The tall coil at a tokamak's core. Ramping its current induces the plasma current, so the plasma itself is the secondary winding of a giant transformer.
block.theoreticalsciences.centrifuge_rot: A thin-walled cylinder spun so fast its rim outruns sound. Heavier molecules crowd towards the wall and lighter ones drift to the axis.
block.theoreticalsciences.chamber_casing: The shell of a chamber where time runs at another rate. Even on Earth, a clock a kilometre higher gains about one part in 10¹³.
block.theoreticalsciences.chance_tiles.l: Tiles laid in no repeating order, each pattern drawn at random. Any stretch that looks designed is a coincidence the dice were always going to throw.
block.theoreticalsciences.chemical_react: A pressure vessel with a catalyst bed, a heater and a stirrer. Most of chemistry is getting the right molecules to meet at the right energy.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_bric: Cherenkov quartz cut into small bricks, each one glowing softly blue along its edges. A wall of them looks like a shallow pool at night. They are smooth and slightly cool to the touch.
A slab of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_lamp: A lamp of Cherenkov quartz with glowstone at its heart, so the blue Cherenkov glow is amplified into a strong, clean light. It is the colour of a reactor pool, and as calming.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_pill: A column of Cherenkov quartz that glows along its length with an even blue. Placed at a doorway it reads like a beam of light holding up the lintel. It is cool and faintly humming.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_quar: Forty pieces of Cherenkov quartz fused into a single block that glows the soft blue of particles outrunning light in a medium.
block.theoreticalsciences.chondrite.lore: A stony meteorite: rock that has not melted since the planets formed. Found in craters out in open country. Gives Chondrite Fragment when mined. Needs a stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronal_accele: Time runs faster for everything in its field, and the universe sends the bill. Each borrowed tick must be paid for, in energy and in Chronon Gas.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronal_field_: A projector that stretches time in its field. A temporal knot sits in the emitter stack, so clocks inside run faster or slower depending on its setting.
block.theoreticalsciences.chrono_loom.lo: Weaves worldlines. Reverses the arrow of time, ties temporal knots and enforces self-consistency on time loops.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronon_field_: Inverts the local arrow of time to harvest chronons.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronoplastic_: A casing laced with tachyon crystal and a chronon capacitor, so that time inside flows at a rate I can adjust.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_bl: Forty chronosteel ingots fused into one block around an empty set: a metal whose atoms keep slightly different time from their surroundings.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_co: A superconducting coil wrapped in chronosteel, so that current inside it runs on its own clock. The field it makes is steadier than any ordinary coil, as though the coil had more time to think.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ha: A chronosteel panel painted with warning stripes, used to mark doorways, machine edges and anything I do not want to walk into. The stripes look very slightly out of step with each other.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_pi: A column of chronosteel, banded and fluted, that carries a load without complaint. It reflects light in a slightly delayed blur and gives a doorway the feel of an engine room.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_pl: Chronosteel rolled into plates and fixed to a block face. Its sheen is cool and slightly blurred, as if the surface had moved a moment before it was seen. It gives a wall a clean, mechanical look.
A slab of Chronosteel Plating, for building with.
Stairs of Chronosteel Plating, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ve: A chronosteel grille that lets air pass between rooms. The slats are angled to keep light out and air moving, and a faint draught always seems to be flowing through it, even when the room is still.
block.theoreticalsciences.climate_casing: Casing for a climate engine. Earth's climate balances about 340 W/m² of incoming sunlight against heat radiated back to space.
block.theoreticalsciences.climate_engine: Changes the air's carbon dioxide and aerosols, and with them how much heat the world keeps: enough to bring rain, clear the sky, or grow ice.
block.theoreticalsciences.cloaking_glass: A pane of metamaterial that bends light around itself, so the glass is nearly invisible from any angle. Only the edges betray it, as a faint distortion in the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.cloud_seeder_s: A stack that releases ice nuclei into supercooled cloud. Silver iodide, the usual agent, has a lattice so like ice that droplets freeze onto it and fall.
block.theoreticalsciences.colloid_cell.l: A thin glass cell of fine grains in water. Unseen molecules jostle them endlessly; in 1908 Perrin watched that jitter and counted the atoms in a mole.
block.theoreticalsciences.compactificati: Rolls extra dimensions up small: Kaluza-Klein circles, Calabi-Yau and G₂ spaces, D-branes and finally M-theory itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_b: A block of matter arranged so that every atom is part of a computation. It is warm to the touch and very slightly noisy, as though it is always working.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_l: A computronium block lit from within by glowstone, its traces brightened into a steady, warm glow. It looks like a terminal screen turned into a lamp.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_p: A panel of computronium with fine glowing traces running across its face, like a circuit board that is thinking. It is warm and faintly busy to the touch.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_t: Computronium cut into tiles, each one lit by faint, shifting traces. A floor of them flickers softly, as if computing something about whoever walks across it.
A slab of Computronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Computronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.concentrator_m: A great curved array of mirrors that gathers light from a field of heliostats onto one focus. The Odeillo furnace reaches about 3,500 °C this way.
block.theoreticalsciences.concept_compre: Takes whole stacks of everything a field of science has produced and compresses them into a single singularity of pure concept.
block.theoreticalsciences.conceptual_cas: Housing for things that are not physical. Its plates are woven from transfinite structure and braced with formal proofs, so that what it contains is held by consistency rather than by strength.
block.theoreticalsciences.containment_fi: Glass that is not really glass, but a field held between two panes with a shimmer of plasma in between.
block.theoreticalsciences.control_rod_dr: The mechanism that raises and lowers a reactor's boron rods. If power fails it simply lets go, and gravity drops the rods into the core.
block.theoreticalsciences.convergence_al: A focus for the pedestals around it, which give up what they hold to a single point, as rays meet at the focus of a lens.
block.theoreticalsciences.convergence_en: Does in a box what the Convergence Altar does with pedestals and patience: every ritual but the Breached Anomaly Engine, fed by pipes like any machine.
block.theoreticalsciences.core_iron.lore: The alloy of planetary cores and iron meteorites, roughly nine parts iron to one of nickel. Etched, it shows Widmanstätten patterns grown over millions of years.
block.theoreticalsciences.core_magnetite: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 1 and 48. Gives Magnetite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.corundum_cryst: Aluminium oxide crystallised in bulk, second only to diamond among common minerals for hardness. A trace of chromium makes it ruby; others, sapphire.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_neutron: Forty ingots of cosmic neutronium fused into a block denser than the inside of a neutron star. It casts a faint, cold shadow even in full light.
A coil of cosmic neutronium over spacetime alloy, cooled cryogenically and threaded with pentaquark shards. It runs hotter than anything below it and seems to pull faintly on the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_plating: Cosmic neutronium rolled into plating, dark as space with faint pinpricks of light. A wall of it looks like a window onto the night sky that happens to be load-bearing.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_ray_ore: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Cosmic Ray Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_tiles.l: Cosmic neutronium cut into dark tiles that seem to have tiny points of light deep inside them, like stars seen through a deep well. The floor they make feels impossibly solid.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_tiles_s: A slab of Cosmic Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Cosmic Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmogenic_cas: A casing built to contain the birth of a universe: spin foam lattice and multiverse shards folded around a rift frame casing.
block.theoreticalsciences.crustal_rock.l: Silicate rock of a planet's crust, the thin cool skin over the mantle: on Earth about 7 km thick beneath the oceans and 35 km under the continents.
block.theoreticalsciences.cryogenic_cool: A jacket of containment field glass around a cryocooler, built to keep superconducting parts close to absolute zero. Frost forms on its outer face within seconds.
block.theoreticalsciences.crystal_growth: A seed is dipped into the melt and drawn slowly up, turning: the melt freezes onto it as one single crystal, and the impurities stay behind.
block.theoreticalsciences.crystal_interf: A rigid, damped cradle for an interferometer cut from one perfect silicon crystal. A neutron splits inside it, and a shake of an atom's width spoils the fringes.
block.theoreticalsciences.cyclotron.lore: Protons spiralling outward between two copper dees, kicked across the gap twice a turn by a radio-frequency voltage that must keep exact step with them.
One of a cyclotron's two hollow D-shaped electrodes. The RF voltage across the gap between them kicks each particle every half turn, so it spirals outward ever faster.
block.theoreticalsciences.cyclotron_yoke: The iron return path of a cyclotron magnet. It carries the flux back from pole to pole, so the field across the gap stays strong and even.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy_si: Taps the energy of empty space that drives the expansion of the universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_matter_co: Gravitationally focuses the invisible halo surrounding every galaxy.
A sealed, shielded vessel where short-lived isotopes live out their half-lives. Radon in its tanks decays on a real clock - a day in a minute - into lead.
block.theoreticalsciences.decontaminatio: Melts radioactive waste into glass, and takes the uranium back out of spent fuel.
block.theoreticalsciences.decorative_tel: A small reflecting telescope on its stand, still pointed at whatever its last observer wanted to see.
block.theoreticalsciences.deep_brine.lor: Deep Brine, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.deep_drilling_: A derrick and a string of drill pipe kilometres long. The deeper the bit, the hotter the rock, the higher the pressure in it - and the older and stranger the core it brings up.
block.theoreticalsciences.deepslate_cher: Found in the Overworld, between Y -64 and 0. Gives Cherenkov Quartz when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.deepslate_pitc: Found in the Overworld, between Y -64 and 0. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_mat: Found in the End, between Y 10 and 80. Gives Degenerate Matter Chunk when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dense_mass_cor: A mass packed so tightly that time itself runs slow around it. Clocks set nearby lose seconds to the rest of the world, and never get them back.
The tall frame over a well that carries the crown block and the whole string of pipe. The word comes from Derrick, a seventeenth-century Tyburn hangman.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilaton_ore.lo: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Dilaton Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_bloc: Dilithium crystals fused into one solid block that rings when struck and glows a soft violet. The resonance carries through the floor, and anything metal nearby picks up a faint hum.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_lamp: A dilithium block with glowstone at its centre, so the violet crystal shines with a soft, even light. It hums a single note when lit.
Found in the Nether, between Y 10 and 110. Gives Dilithium Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_li: A lift that pushes along an extra dimension. With a tesseract core set inside the emitter stack, it can nudge anything in its field slightly outside ordinary space, where weight no longer applies.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_re: Dimensional Residue, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_st: A stabiliser that holds the number of dimensions in a region fixed while machines nearby try to change it. A dimensional stabiliser matrix sets the count, and a field emitter enforces it.
block.theoreticalsciences.dipole_bending: A superconducting dipole magnet on a neutronium frame that bends a charged particle beam into a circle. Its field is perfectly uniform across the gap. Metal tools drift toward it.
block.theoreticalsciences.dish_truss.lor: The steel frame behind a radio dish. It must hold the surface true to a fraction of a wavelength while the whole dish tilts and sags under its own weight.
block.theoreticalsciences.disk_confineme: A ring of magnets that shapes the field around an accretion disk. In real disks, tangled fields drive the turbulence that lets gas shed its spin and fall inward.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_black_: A real one, very small, held on a pedestal. It bends the light behind it.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_dyson_: A star wrapped in a swarm of collectors.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_galaxy: Two hundred billion stars, more or less, in two spiral arms.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_penter: The shadow of a five-dimensional cube. It has 32 corners and 80 edges.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_pocket: A whole universe, still expanding, in a jar.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_pulsar: A neutron star spinning hundreds of times a second, sweeping its beams across the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_quasar: A feeding black hole outshining its host galaxy.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_tesser: A four-dimensional cube turning through itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_white_: Nothing can enter it. Light pours out forever.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_wormho: The other mouth is somewhere else. Do not put your hand in.
Moves a gamma source at speeds of a fraction of a micrometre per second, so its Doppler shift can cancel the tiny shift that gravity puts on its light.
block.theoreticalsciences.drill_string.l: Lengths of steel pipe screwed end to end that turn the bit and carry mud down to it. Kilometres of it wind up like a spring before the bit begins to turn.
block.theoreticalsciences.dust_cloud.lor: A cloud of dust grains, too thin to stand on. Now and then, broken, it leaves Interstellar Dust.
block.theoreticalsciences.dust_ice_ore.l: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Interstellar Dust when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dyson_array.lo: Surrounds a captive star with a swarm, and eventually a sphere, of collectors.
block.theoreticalsciences.einstein_ring_: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Einstein Ring Lens when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.einstein_rosen: A wormhole made solid: one mouth here, the other somewhere far away, joined by a throat through curved spacetime. Peering into it, I see the far side foreshortened and tinted.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_cache.l: Thrown out of a white hole with everything else. A white hole is a black hole run backwards: nothing can enter, so this has never been opened from outside.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_ore.lor: Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Primordial Ejecta when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_rock.lo: Stone thrown outward from somewhere nothing should leave. Its grains are shocked and blistered, as if fired out of a white hole, and the strata run backwards: newest at the bottom, oldest on top.
block.theoreticalsciences.electrolytic_c: Two electrodes in a conducting liquid: drive a current through it and it comes apart into what it was made of.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_rela: Two halves of a quantum pair, each locked inside a small housing. Whatever happens to one is correlated with the other, however far apart they sit.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_tran: Sends to (or receives from) every other transceiver on the same channel, at any distance. Sneak-use to switch between sending and receiving; an Entanglement Tuner sets the channel.
block.theoreticalsciences.entanglement_n: A junction that keeps entangled pairs until they are wanted. Their correlations are perfect, yet no message can ride on them: no-signalling sees to that.
block.theoreticalsciences.entropy_horizo: A ring of event-horizon casing that runs a universe forward to its end: stars burn out, protons decay, black holes evaporate, and the horizon glows at its own faint temperature over what is left.
block.theoreticalsciences.entropy_sink.l: A copper heat sink for computation. By Landauer's principle every bit erased gives off at least kT ln 2 of heat, and something has to carry it away.
Shares the halves of entangled pairs between two distant mouths - weaving, if Maldacena and Susskind are right, a wormhole between them.
block.theoreticalsciences.eschaton_found: A sphere of Pleroma glass on a waist of Omnipotence casing, ringed in Logos coil and watched by four towers. It packs as much as the laws allow into as little space as they allow - right up to the edge of becoming a black hole - and repeats what you once forged by hand.
block.theoreticalsciences.essence_distil: A tower of fractionation trays wound with chronosteel coils. Pour in every fluid one mod has and it boils them together, tray after tray, until what is left is a single fluid that stands for all of them: that mod's Essence.
block.theoreticalsciences.euclid_reliqua: A casket laid out in Euclid's proportions. The Elements rest on five postulates, and the fifth, on parallel lines, was doubted for two thousand years.
block.theoreticalsciences.evaporator_shi: Lead-lined housing for a radioactive evaporator. The water boils away cleanly; everything dangerous it carried stays behind, and stays concentrated.
block.theoreticalsciences.event_horizon_: A casing with a dark metamaterial skin over spacetime casing and neutronium plate: whatever reaches it from inside does not come back out.
block.theoreticalsciences.evolution_engi: A biodome where generations of designed life live and die in seconds. Run it inside a fast chronal field and a million years pass in a minute.
block.theoreticalsciences.ex_nihilo_engi: Creation from nothing, made a machine. It does not convert energy - it simply has it.
A tall brick chimney. The hot gas inside is lighter than the air outside, so the taller the stack, the harder it draws.
Exotic Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Exotic Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.extreme_assemb: A crafting table with a 9x9 grid, for the recipes too large for any other.
block.theoreticalsciences.eye_of_the_hor: A captive black hole wrapped in anchors, lenses and stabilisers, used as a computer: it simulates entire stars, galaxies and universes, and keeps what falls out.
block.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum.l: False Vacuum, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.feed_horn.lore: A flared metal waveguide at the focus of a dish. It funnels the faint reflected radio waves into the receiver and turns a deaf ear to whatever comes from the sides.
block.theoreticalsciences.femto_fabricat: Builds components smaller than a proton - and assembles them into processors.
block.theoreticalsciences.femtoscale_ass: A long line of robotic arms and fabrication heads for the most complex assemblies: high-tier processors and late-game machine controllers.
block.theoreticalsciences.ferrofluid.lor: Ferrofluid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
A compact emitter of neutronium plate, Cherenkov quartz and a quantum dot that projects a field shaped by the dot's quantum state. Change the state, change the field.
block.theoreticalsciences.fission_fragme: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 36 and 126. Gives Fission Fragment Mix when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_bubble.lo: A pocket of space sitting in a higher-energy vacuum than its surroundings, metastable and patient. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_cache.lor: Held together by a bubble of stable vacuum. Spacetime at the Planck scale may seethe with fluctuations; inside, it has been made to keep still.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_substrate: Spongy, effervescent matter scooped from below the Planck length. Bubbles of spacetime swell and vanish inside it so fast the block seems to fizz without making a sound.
block.theoreticalsciences.focus_receiver: The target at a lens's focal point, where light gathered over a broad aperture converges onto one small spot. It has to survive what it receives.
block.theoreticalsciences.forged_omnipot: An Omnipotence Core forged anew. Unbreakable; only the Hand of the Demiurge can attune, wake or move it.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractal_lattic: A block of the Platonic Realm's fractal lattice, for building with - and an ingredient of its machines.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractal_ore.lo: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Fractal Dust when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractionation_: A casing of containment field glass and chronosteel over event horizon casing, made to separate fluids by mass and charge in a tall spire. Watching through the glass, the layers settle into neat bands.
A tall distillation spire that separates Dimensional Residue and Warm Helium into useful fractions.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractured_real: What a failing multiblock leaks: a higher-dimensional shadow that spreads from block to block like an infection.
block.theoreticalsciences.frontier_regol: Rock ground to dust by billions of years of micrometeorites. Assayed in bulk it gives back its interstellar dust and a little rare earth.
block.theoreticalsciences.frozen_light_o: Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Frozen Photon when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.galton_board.l: Twelve rows of pegs. Every piece bounces left or right at each, and where it lands sorts it: most near the middle, a few far out in the tails.
block.theoreticalsciences.garnet_crystal: A mass of garnet, the dodecahedral silicate that grows where rock is buried and heated. Its zoned layers record the pressures it passed through.
block.theoreticalsciences.gas_centrifuge: Rotors spinning faster than sound fling the heavier isotope outward. One stage enriches a little; a tower of them, a lot. Build it taller for more stages: each new layer on top is one more.
block.theoreticalsciences.gene_sequencer: Reads a genome letter by letter - and, run backwards, writes one.
block.theoreticalsciences.geode_shell.lo: A hollow stone lined with crystals that grew inward, one layer at a time, from mineral-rich water seeping through the cavity over ages.
block.theoreticalsciences.golden_ratio_g: Glass made with a transcendental crystal so that its proportions follow the golden ratio at every scale. Each pane is divided into smaller panes in the same ratio, forever.
block.theoreticalsciences.goniometer.lor: A precision turntable that sets sample and detector at exact angles. The detector swings twice as far as the crystal, keeping θ and 2θ in step.
block.theoreticalsciences.graphite_moder: Pure graphite slows fission neutrons by collision with carbon nuclei, which seldom absorb them. Chicago Pile-1 was a stack of such blocks, in 1942.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_conde: Quantises gravity itself - gravitons, spin foam and the anchors of reality.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_field: A field emitter upgraded with a graviton crystal and a gravitic lens element, so it projects gravity as well as fields. It weighs more on one side than the other, and that side changes.
Projects a field around a structure; what the field is decides what the machine inside can do.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_lens_: An array of gravitic lens elements that bend spacetime to focus gravitational waves, the way a glass lens bends light. Inside, the space seems to pinch toward the centre.
block.theoreticalsciences.growth_furnace: The insulated shell of a crystal-growth furnace. Its job is calm: the steadier the heat around the melt, the fewer flaws freeze into the crystal.
block.theoreticalsciences.harmonic_pedes: A pedestal tuned to resonance. What is set on it rings at whole-number multiples of one frequency, as the harmonics of a single string do.
block.theoreticalsciences.hawking_radiat: A collector of Hawking absorber plates and entangled photons that catches the faint radiation evaporating black holes give off. It is warm, and the warmth comes from somewhere it should not.
block.theoreticalsciences.heavy_water.lo: Heavy Water, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.heliostat.lore: A mirror that tracks the Sun on two axes. At Odeillo, sixty-three of them feed one parabolic concentrator whose focus passes 3,000 °C.
block.theoreticalsciences.helium3_detect: A tube of helium-3 gas. A slow neutron splits a nucleus into a proton and a triton with 764 keV between them, and the gas lights up with charge.
block.theoreticalsciences.hex_glass.lore: Glass held together by a hexagonal force field, like a honeycomb of light. Each cell glows faintly at its edges. It is strong and very slightly warm to the touch.
block.theoreticalsciences.higgs_field_mo: Tunes the Higgs field locally to strip mass from matter - or make it negative.
Brick moulded to the standards of Hilbert's programme: every face a rigorous statement, every joint a valid inference.
block.theoreticalsciences.hilbert_locker: Always full, and always room for one more. Move each item up one shelf, and the first shelf is free again, however many there are.
block.theoreticalsciences.holographic_en: Writes a volume of matter onto its own boundary surface, per the holographic principle.
A locker whose lid is an event horizon held open. While it stays shut, what is inside lies beyond the causal reach of everything else.
block.theoreticalsciences.horizon_cage.l: A cage of fields for something with no surface to grip. A black hole cannot be touched, so it must be held by its charge alone.
block.theoreticalsciences.horizon_contai: Walls built to hold a region where escape velocity reaches light speed. Nothing leaves through a horizon; the walls are for what has not fallen in yet.
A pane cut from the boundary of no return. Light enters easily but seems reluctant to leave, so everything beyond looks slightly dimmed and stretched.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_cloud: Ionised hydrogen glowing red at 656 nm, the H-alpha line. You can walk straight through it.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperframe_cas: A casing laced with topological insulator and superposition crystal, so that its interior exists in several overlapping configurations at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_plas: Hypernova Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperreal_cach: Its walls obey whatever law is currently in force. The contents, like infinitesimals beside the real numbers, sit at a scale no ordinary rule can reach.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperspherical: Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Hypersphere Fragment when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.hypervelocity_: A railgun: an armature shot down two rails at kilometres a second into a target, where the shock makes what only impacts can.
block.theoreticalsciences.impact_breccia: Rock shattered and welded back together in the instant of an impact. It lines a meteorite crater's bowl and rim.
block.theoreticalsciences.impact_chamber: An armoured chamber for hypervelocity tests. Above about 3 km/s, a projectile carries more energy per kilogram than the same mass of TNT.
block.theoreticalsciences.induction_gene: A coil spun inside a permanent magnet's field by a small turbine. Stronger magnets give more power; flowing water beside it spins it faster.
block.theoreticalsciences.infall_rock.lo: Rock stretched and compressed on its way toward a black hole. Its grains are elongated along one axis by tidal forces, and the light from it arrives reddened and slow.
block.theoreticalsciences.inflation_cham: A sphere of containment glass around a pocket of false vacuum, wound with coils and lensed by gravitons. The inflaton inside rolls down its potential slowly enough to inflate - and then it reheats, and a universe's worth of matter is made.
block.theoreticalsciences.inner_core_bou: The floor of the Planetary Interior: the edge of the solid inner core, 5,150 km down.
block.theoreticalsciences.interface_port: Takes the place of a structure's block to let items, fluids and energy in and out (or to link an ME network). Sneak-use with an empty hand to make it pull ingredients from, or push products into, the blocks beside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.interferometer: Splits a beam of light, sends the halves down two paths and brings them back together. A change in path of a fraction of a wavelength moves the fringes.
block.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_s: Sweeps up the thin gas and dust between the stars. Only high above the world, or out in space.
block.theoreticalsciences.ionic_liquid.l: Ionic Liquid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.iridium_crucib: A crucible of iridium, which melts at 2,446 °C and shrugs off most molten oxides. Laser crystals such as YAG are pulled from melts held in one.
block.theoreticalsciences.iron_meteorite: The iron-nickel mass of a meteorite, half buried where it struck. Found in craters out in open country. Gives Meteoric Iron when mined. Needs a stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.irradiation_ch: Holds a target in the neutron flux of a source until nuclei catch neutrons and become something else.
block.theoreticalsciences.isomer_trigger: A gamma pulse knocks a hafnium-178m2 nucleus out of its long-lived state, and all its stored energy comes out at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.jet_collimator: A magnetic nozzle that pinches a plasma flow into a narrow beam, much as twisted field lines are thought to shape the jets of quasars and young stars.
block.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_o: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Kaluza-Klein Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.koch_crystal.l: A pane whose rim is a Koch snowflake: a finite area enclosed by an infinitely long border. The glass is clear, but its edge glitters endlessly as each tiny triangle catches light.
block.theoreticalsciences.kugelblitz_cha: Focuses so much light into one point that it collapses into a black hole.
block.theoreticalsciences.laser_cutter.l: A focused beam that cuts copper, silicon and diamond to a micron.
block.theoreticalsciences.laser_interfer: Two long arms at right angles, a laser split between them, and mirrors that hang free. A passing gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other by a thousandth of a proton's width.
block.theoreticalsciences.lattice_growth: Grows flawless single-crystal boules atom by atom in a superfluid bath.
block.theoreticalsciences.lead_bricks.lo: Bricks of lead shielding. Lead is dense and has many electrons, so it stops gamma rays well - about half of them every 1.3 cm - but it does little against neutrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.lead_hazard_pa: A lead panel striped for danger: decoration for shielded rooms, and it stops gamma rays like any lead.
block.theoreticalsciences.lead_shielding: Dense lead for stopping gamma rays. Each half-value layer halves the dose; for the gammas of cobalt-60 that is about 1.2 cm of lead.
block.theoreticalsciences.leaded_glass.l: Glass with lead oxide melted in, often over half by weight. Lead's dense electron clouds stop X-rays and gamma rays while visible light passes through.
block.theoreticalsciences.lens_array_blo: A grid of lenses working side by side, each forming its own small image of the scene. Together they see from many points at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.lens_grinder.l: A turning lap that wears glass into a curve with ever finer grit, then polishes it. Spinoza earned part of his living at one.
block.theoreticalsciences.lens_pylon.lor: A mast that holds mass where its curvature bends passing light. A gravitational lens has no single focal point: it brings light together along a line.
block.theoreticalsciences.lensing_concen: Lines a star up behind a mass and collects the light the mass bends together: an Einstein ring, made into power.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_antihel: Liquid Antihelium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Liquid Sodium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_spaceti: Liquid Spacetime, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.lithography_gl: Containment field glass doped with quantum dots so that light passing through it is shaped at nanometre resolution. It projects patterns far finer than its own grain.
block.theoreticalsciences.lithostatic_ca: A casing built to bear the load of rock. In Earth's crust, lithostatic pressure rises by about 27 MPa for every kilometre of depth.
block.theoreticalsciences.logos_coil_blo: A coil wound of Logos Thread, the word that puts things in order. Current through it does not so much make a field as insist on one.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetar_crust: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Magnetar Crust Fragment when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_confi: A casing that holds plasma away from its own walls with superconducting magnetic fields, tuned by dilithium. It works on the same principle as a tokamak.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetite_bloc: Compacted Fe₃O₄, the most strongly magnetic mineral in nature. Lodestones, magnetite probably magnetised by lightning, made the first compasses.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetite_bric: Bricks of magnetite (Fe3O4), the most magnetic mineral in nature. Iron oxide is dense, so it also shields: it stops gamma rays about two thirds as well as lead, and neutrons three times better.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetizer.lor: A coil around an iron core that pulses a field through a magnet blank. Only a field stronger than the blank's coercivity sets it.
A hole bored through bedrock by the Core Drill.
block.theoreticalsciences.markov_chain_r: Three vats in a ring, the feed hopping between them by tuned chances. Where it spends its time - the chain's steady state - decides what it becomes.
block.theoreticalsciences.markov_vat.lor: A vat whose contents change from one state to the next by chance alone. Where they go next depends only on where they are now, never on how they got there.
block.theoreticalsciences.matrioshka_bra: Nested shells of computronium around a star. It thinks; you gain Insight.
block.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_demon_: A molecular gatekeeper that sorts fast particles from slow ones, defying the second law of thermodynamics.
block.theoreticalsciences.metallic_hydro: Liquid Metallic Hydrogen, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.metamaterial_w: Lays down sub-wavelength lattices that bend light (and gravity) the wrong way.
block.theoreticalsciences.mhd_channel_ca: The duct of a magnetohydrodynamic generator. Hot conducting gas rushes through a magnetic field, and current is drawn straight off electrodes in its walls, with no turbine at all.
An electrode lining a magnetohydrodynamic channel. Conducting fluid swept through a magnetic field drives current straight into it, with no turbine at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.mhd_field_magn: The magnet across an MHD channel. Conducting fluid driven through its field makes current at right angles to both, and the output rises with the square of the field.
A conducting fluid driven through a magnetic field makes current with no moving parts: the flow itself is the armature.
block.theoreticalsciences.micro_black_ho: A black hole lighter than a mountain, held in a cage and fed as fast as it evaporates: it glows with Hawking radiation hotter than any star.
block.theoreticalsciences.microscope_col: The tube that holds a microscope's objective and eyepiece at a fixed distance apart. No light microscope resolves much finer than about 200 nm.
block.theoreticalsciences.mirror_foundry: A stack of Penning traps: anti-ores are melted, refined and cast without ever touching a wall - and matter and antimatter are bound into one alloy.
block.theoreticalsciences.moduli_ore.lor: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Moduli Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.moissanite_cry: Silicon carbide, found by Henri Moissan in a meteorite crater in 1893. Nearly as hard as diamond, it splits light into colours even more strongly.
block.theoreticalsciences.molten_salt_fu: Molten Salt Fuel, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.molten_salt_re: Uranium dissolved in molten fluoride salt flows through a core of graphite and goes critical there. Tune it to exactly one neutron per neutron.
block.theoreticalsciences.monte_carlo_en: Halls of random-number cores that answer by throwing dice: sample enough and the error falls as one over the square root of the count.
block.theoreticalsciences.mossbauer_abso: Iron-57 bound so firmly in its crystal that it soaks up 14.4 keV gamma rays without recoil, a resonance sharp enough to feel one part in a thousand trillion.
block.theoreticalsciences.multiverse_rif: Holds open a tear into neighbouring universes and harvests what leaks through.
block.theoreticalsciences.nanite_assembl: A molecular foundry that builds machines atom by atom - including machines that build themselves.
Nanite Slurry, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.nebular_ice.lo: Water, carbon monoxide and ammonia frozen together on dust grains at about fifteen kelvin. Starlight slowly builds larger molecules within it.
block.theoreticalsciences.neural_synthes: Grows photonic neural networks and the artificial minds that run on them.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_conde: Traps the ghost particles that pass through planets without noticing.
A tube whose walls reflect slow neutrons at grazing angles, much as a glass fibre carries light. Guides lead beams tens of metres from a reactor to the instruments.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutron_interf: A neutron's wave split by a perfect silicon crystal and joined again. Tilt it, and gravity pulls one path more than the other: quantum mechanics and gravity in one measurement.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutron_star_f: Recreates the crushing interior of a collapsed star: neutronium, metallic hydrogen and quark matter.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_blo: A cube of compacted neutronium, matter in which electrons and protons have been crushed together into neutrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_bri: Neutronium Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_pil: A pillar of Neutronium, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_pla: Neutronium rolled into flat plates and riveted onto a block face. It is grey, dense and almost reflective, with seams that look as though they were drawn with a ruler.
A slab of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
A wall of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_til: Neutronium Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.nucleosynthesi: Takes a star through its whole life - collapse, ignition, giant phase, death - and keeps the elements it forges.
A heavy-ion accelerator firing into a spinning target: fuses nuclei into elements beyond the periodic table, aiming for the island of stability.
block.theoreticalsciences.nutrient_broth: Nutrient Broth, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_ca: A locker held in stasis by superconducting coils. Whoever sealed it meant the contents to be found exactly as they were left.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_do: A rotating hemispherical roof with a shuttered slit, turned to keep pace with the telescope so it always looks out through the opening.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_wa: A wall of Observatory, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.observer_plate: A structural plate. Hold Shift to see which structures take it.
block.theoreticalsciences.oklo_rock.lore: Host rock of the Natural Reactor, modelled on Oklo in Gabon, where two billion years ago groundwater slowed neutrons enough for uranium ore to run as a fission reactor for hundreds of thousands of years.
block.theoreticalsciences.oklo_uraninite: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 36 and 126. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.omega_simulato: Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again - inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_casing: The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_engine: Simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law - and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_ca: Material that refuses to be broken by anything made in the ordinary world: no vanilla tool touches it - only the mod's own (the tag theoreticalsciences:omnipotent_tools).
block.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_co: The Core of the Transcendental itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnium_block.l: A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnium_energy_: The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping.
A rigid, flat rail on which lenses, slits and mirrors are clamped in line. Optics is mostly alignment, and this is where alignment is kept.
block.theoreticalsciences.optical_worksh: Grinding spindles, polishing laps and an interferometer: blanks become lenses, plates and gratings, true to a fraction of a wavelength.
block.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_ore.lo: Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Ordinal Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_recurs: Counts past infinity: takes a limit, adds one, and keeps going - omega, omega plus one, omega times two, omega squared, epsilon-naught...
Stone laid down in well-ordered strata. Every layer has a next one, and every collection of layers has a first; even the infinite stacks have a successor waiting above them.
block.theoreticalsciences.oxygen_cloud.l: Doubly ionised oxygen glowing green-blue at 501 nm. You can walk straight through it.
block.theoreticalsciences.page_curve_ana: Follows the entropy of a black hole's radiation as it evaporates - and finds the information coming back out.
block.theoreticalsciences.pair_source.lo: A laser through a nonlinear crystal. Now and then one photon splits into two whose polarisations are entangled: measure one and the other is already decided.
block.theoreticalsciences.particle_spect: Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one.
block.theoreticalsciences.peano_engine.l: Builds number systems the way mathematicians did: zero, then "the next one", then negatives, fractions, reals and beyond.
block.theoreticalsciences.penrose_ergosp: Extracts the rotational energy of a spinning black hole via the Penrose process.
block.theoreticalsciences.peridot_crysta: Peridot Crystal Mass: the ground of one of the strange places beyond the Overworld.
block.theoreticalsciences.peridotite.lor: The dense green rock of the upper mantle, mostly olivine. Brought up into water and air, it slowly drinks them in and turns to serpentinite.
block.theoreticalsciences.photoresist.lo: Quantum-Dot Photoresist, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.pitchblende_or: Found in the Overworld, between Y 0 and 48. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
Armour for working at the smallest length that means anything.
Slices boules into wafers, and wafers into dies, along cuts one Planck length wide.
block.theoreticalsciences.planetesimal_c: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Exoplanet Core Sample when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.plasma_crucibl: A casing of chronosteel around magnetic confinement and superconducting coils, built to hold plasma at stellar temperatures for as long as needed.
block.theoreticalsciences.plasma_injecti: A nozzle that fires plasma into a confinement chamber at a precisely controlled rate. Magnetic confinement steers it, a cryocooler keeps the coils cold, and the tip glows white when in use.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma.lore: Pleroma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_conflu: Fills with a million mB of water, lava and every fluid of the mod, plus 64,000 mB of every mod's Essence, and condenses them into Pleroma.
Named for the Gnostics' Pleroma, the fullness of all that is. Light passes through it; nothing else is allowed to.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_recons: A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back - until the dimension it remembers exists again.
block.theoreticalsciences.polished_chere: Quartz polished to carry Cherenkov light, the blue glow given off when a charged particle outruns light in the glass, at about two-thirds of c.
block.theoreticalsciences.polished_dilit: Dilithium cut and polished to a flawless face. Real dilithium, Li₂, is a fleeting molecule of lithium vapour; this crystal answers to fiction instead.
block.theoreticalsciences.pound_rebka_to: Gamma rays climbing a tower lose energy to gravity. A source moving at the right speed - less than a micrometre a second - puts them back in tune with the absorber above.
block.theoreticalsciences.precision_asse: A casing of neutronium plate around a photonic processor and a femtoscale inductor, built so that nothing inside it vibrates by more than a fraction of a proton. It is dead silent and dead still.
block.theoreticalsciences.press_ram.lore: The working piston of a hydraulic press. A small pump pushes on a broad face, and Pascal's principle multiplies the force by the ratio of their areas.
block.theoreticalsciences.primary_mirror: The cradle that holds a telescope's main mirror, propping its back at many points so the glass does not sag out of shape as the tube tilts.
block.theoreticalsciences.prime_number_o: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Prime Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.primordial_law: Primordial Law, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.primordial_sou: Primordial Soup, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_assistan: Checks proofs one axiom at a time. Logic, set theory and category theory are all built here.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_floor.lo: Flat, even and featureless, like the axioms beneath a theorem. Everything above it stands only because it does not give way.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_membrane: A sheet stretched across the gap between premise and conclusion. Every step of the argument is a fibre in it, and one false step tears it through.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_wall.lor: A wall of Living Proof, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.protostar_frag: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Protostellar Ember when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.pull_shaft.lor: A slow, steady drive that draws its load upward at a controlled rate. In a crystal puller it lifts the seed exactly as fast as the crystal grows.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_crust.l: Iron from a neutron star's crust: a lattice of nuclei in a sea of electrons, held under a field of some hundred million tesla.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_timing_: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Pulsar Timing Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsed_lab_cas: Steel walls lined with mesh, built to keep the sharp spikes of pulsed experiments in and stray radio noise out. A Faraday cage, in effect.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsed_magnet_: A coil of Bitter plates and a room of capacitors dumped into it: a field of up to a hundred tesla, for a few milliseconds.
block.theoreticalsciences.quadrupole_foc: A quadrupole magnet with four pole tips that squeeze a particle beam in one direction while stretching it in the other. Pairs of them focus a beam the way lenses focus light.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_entang: Spontaneous parametric down-conversion splits photons into entangled pairs, then binds them into qubits.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_error_: A core that protects a quantum computer's fragile states by spreading each logical qubit across many physical ones and fixing errors as they happen. It hums with a steady, careful rhythm.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_lithog: Engraves logic onto wafers through a lens. The lens is a catalyst and is never consumed.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_spacet: Quantum Spacetime Condensate, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_co: A ring accelerator that smashes heavy nuclei into quark-gluon plasma.
block.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_pl: Quark-Gluon Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.radio_dish_pan: One curved panel of a radio dish. Its surface need only be true to a small fraction of the wavelength, so for long waves even wire mesh will do.
block.theoreticalsciences.radio_telescop: A dish that listens to the sky: to cold hydrogen, to pulsars. It works by day and in rain, but every machine running nearby is noise in its receiver.
block.theoreticalsciences.radiometer_mas: A mast of radiometers weighing incoming sunlight against outgoing heat. A planet's climate hangs on that balance, a few watts per square metre either way.
block.theoreticalsciences.radium_lamp.lo: Radium mixed with phosphor glows for years without power. The dial painters of the 1920s, who pointed their brushes with their lips, paid for that glow.
block.theoreticalsciences.rail_conductor: One of a pair of heavy rails. Current runs up one, across the armature and back down the other, and the magnetic force flings the armature along them.
block.theoreticalsciences.raw_star_matte: Raw Star Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.reactor_vessel: Thick steel for a reactor's pressure vessel. It must hold the core for decades while neutrons slowly make the metal more brittle.
block.theoreticalsciences.reality_compil: If the universe is a simulation, this decompiles it.
block.theoreticalsciences.reality_lattic: A casing that contains computronium and a Bekenstein crystal to keep track of every bit of information inside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.redshift_tower: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.
block.theoreticalsciences.refinery_casin: Casing for a refinery that runs on chance. Each stage passes its product to the next by probability alone, and the averages come out exact.
block.theoreticalsciences.reflecting_tel: A mirror under a dome, its slit open to the night. The bigger the mirror and the longer the exposure, the fainter the stars it records - on a clear, dark night, under open sky.
block.theoreticalsciences.refractory_fir: A fire chamber lined with firebrick, which keeps its strength far above the heat that slumps common brick. The fire stays in, and most of the heat does too.
block.theoreticalsciences.reheating_plas: Reheating Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.relativity_bre: Relativity Breakdown, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.renormalised_e: Renormalised Essence, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.research_nexus: A ring of error-corrected cores around a well of light that reads Research Dossiers and studies them in your place, shortening whatever you are researching.
block.theoreticalsciences.research_termi: Where research is done: spend Insight here to study what comes next.
block.theoreticalsciences.resonance_pede: A pedestal tuned to ring in sympathy with its neighbours, as a wine glass sings to a matching note. The first and plainest of its kind.
block.theoreticalsciences.retrocausal_or: Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Retrocausal Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.return_rift.lo: A tear in space that leads back the way it came. Of all the doors in these places, it is the one that always opens onto home.
block.theoreticalsciences.rf_acceleratin: A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.
The heart of a cyclotron. It drives the gap at the cyclotron frequency, qB/2πm, which does not change with speed, so a circling particle is kicked every half turn.
block.theoreticalsciences.rich_copper_or: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 50 and 126. Gives Rich Copper Chunk when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 12 and 96. Gives Rich Gold Chunk when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 50 and 126. Gives Rich Iron Chunk when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.rift_frame_cas: A casing reinforced against tearing open: void lattice, graviton crystal and chronosteel over a hyperframe.
block.theoreticalsciences.rim_slag.lore: Cinder flung from the inner edge of an accretion disk, where gas spirals in at a fair fraction of light speed and is heated to millions of degrees.
block.theoreticalsciences.ringwoodite_or: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 4 and 84. Gives Ringwoodite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.salt_heat_exch: Passes heat between molten salt and water. Nitrate salt stays liquid from about 220 to 565 °C, so it can carry heat that would boil water off at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.satellite_wrec: The scorched frame and panels of a satellite that came down. Most burn up on re-entry; this one did not, quite.
block.theoreticalsciences.schrodinger_li: Schrödinger's Limit, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.scintillator_p: A sheet that gives a brief flash of light whenever a charged particle passes through. Walls of them catch cosmic-ray showers as they rain down.
block.theoreticalsciences.seismic_isolat: Springs and dampers that cut a mirror off from the ground. Ground tremor dwarfs the 10⁻¹⁸ m a passing gravitational wave stretches an interferometer arm.
block.theoreticalsciences.seismograph.lo: A heavy pendulum that the ground moves under. It times two kinds of wave from below - fast pressure waves and slow shear waves - and the gap between them says how deep their source lies.
block.theoreticalsciences.singularity_co: Feed it a great many of one item and it compacts them into a singularity - no timer, as fast as you feed it.
block.theoreticalsciences.singularity_en: At the centre of this cell sits a tiny singularity, wrapped in cosmic neutronium. Energy falls into it and is held behind the horizon until it is needed.
Heliostats turn with the Sun and feed a parabolic mirror wall, which brings their light to a point. Concentrated ten thousand times, sunlight melts what no fuel flame can.
block.theoreticalsciences.solar_receiver: The target at the focus of a mirror field, built to drink in concentrated sunlight. At Odeillo such a focus reaches some 3,500 °C.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_allo: Forty spacetime alloy ingots pressed into one block. The alloy bends spacetime around itself slightly, so the block's edges never look quite square.
A grade of structure coil. Better coils make the machines built with them faster - hold Shift to see which.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_anch: A pylon that pins a patch of spacetime in place, built around a spacetime anchor core and a chronosteel coil. The ground around it feels unusually solid, as if gravity had made its mind up.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_bric: Spacetime Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_casi: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_pane: A panel of spacetime alloy whose surface seems to bend inward slightly, as if the wall behind it were further away than it is. It is cool, smooth and very faintly disorienting to look at for long.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_tile: Spacetime Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.spectrograph.l: A slit, a grating and a plate. Light comes in as one colour and leaves as a rainbow crossed with dark lines, and every line is an element's fingerprint.
block.theoreticalsciences.spent_fuel_sal: Spent Fuel Salt, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.spin_network_l: Weaves quanta of area and volume into a spin network: space, a grain at a time.
block.theoreticalsciences.station_hull.l: Aluminium skin and stringers from a spacecraft, thin enough to dent by hand. In vacuum, a few millimetres of it is all that separates air from nothing.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_contai: A plate of degenerate armour and spacetime alloy over magnetic confinement casing, built to hold back the pressure and heat of a star. It is impossibly heavy and faintly warm.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_frame_: A casing of neutronium plate over event horizon casing with a Higgs field capacitor to steady its mass. It is built to hold the weight and heat of a star, and it glows faintly gold at the seams.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_lamp.l: A stellar frame casing with glowstone at its heart, so it shines with a warm, golden light like a small star seen through a window. It is warm to stand next to.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_plasma: Stellar Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Melts and alloys matter in plasma as hot as a stellar core. Makes Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium and Exotic Solder.
block.theoreticalsciences.step_laser.lor: A laser whose pulse makes a moving step in the refractive index of glass. Light trying to overtake the step is slowed to a halt at it: an event horizon for light.
block.theoreticalsciences.stochastic_cor: A bank of random sources for Monte Carlo sums. The error falls as one over the square root of the samples: a hundred times the dice for ten times the accuracy.
block.theoreticalsciences.strained_space: Strained Spacetime, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.strange_matter: Strange Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.string_resonan: Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes.
block.theoreticalsciences.superconductin: A drum of superconducting coil wound around spacetime casing. Current, once started, circulates in it forever with no loss at all. The field it makes tugs gently at anything metal nearby.
Superconducting Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.supercritical_: Supercritical Solvent, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Supercritical Water, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.superfluid_hel: Superfluid Helium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.synaptic_fluid: Synaptic Fluid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.synchrotron.lo: A ring accelerator built from real beamline parts: bending dipoles, focusing quadrupoles, RF cavities, cryogenics, vacuum pumps and a detector hall. It makes the exotic hadrons nothing else can.
block.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_resona: Resonates a crystal lattice until it emits particles that travel faster than light.
block.theoreticalsciences.tectonic_press: A multi-anvil press over a firebox: it squeezes rock to the pressures of the deep mantle and bakes it to match. What crystallises depends on where on the phase diagram you hold it.
block.theoreticalsciences.telescope_pier: A heavy masonry column for a telescope to stand on, built apart from the dome floor so that footsteps never shake the image.
block.theoreticalsciences.telescope_tube: Holds a telescope's mirrors in exact alignment and is blackened inside, so the only light that reaches the focus is light from the sky.
Computes in curved spacetime: Lorentz transformations, metrics, curvature and finally Einstein's field equations.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesla_coil.lor: A resonant transformer: a spark-gap primary ringing in tune with a tall secondary steps a few kilovolts up to millions, and the toroid throws arcs metres long.
A few turns of heavy copper fed by a capacitor and a spark gap. Tuned to the secondary, it rings its energy across into the tall coil beside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesla_secondar: The tall, finely wound coil of a Tesla transformer. Tuned to resonate with the primary, it builds hundreds of kilovolts at its crown.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesla_toroid.l: The smooth metal doughnut atop a Tesla coil. Its broad curve spreads the charge and holds off corona, so the voltage climbs higher before sparks break out.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesseract_asse: Folds matter through a fourth spatial dimension.
block.theoreticalsciences.test_mass_cham: A vacuum chamber that hangs a polished fused-silica mirror on fine fibres, isolated from every tremor so it moves only when spacetime does.
block.theoreticalsciences.thermoelectric: A furnace wrapped in thermocouples: the heat of ordinary fuel, turned straight into current by the Seebeck effect. Humble - and the first power any laboratory has.
block.theoreticalsciences.tidal_ore.lore: Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Tidal Alloy Scrap when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.tidal_plasma.l: Tidal Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.tilt_table.lor: A table that tilts a neutron interferometer about its beam. In 1975 one let Colella, Overhauser and Werner see gravity shift a single neutron's quantum phase.
block.theoreticalsciences.time_dilation_: Holds its samples deep in the gravity well of a dense core, where their clocks run slow against the world outside.
block.theoreticalsciences.tokamak.lore: A ring of hydrogen plasma held off its walls by a twisted magnetic field, hot enough for deuterium and tritium to fuse.
block.theoreticalsciences.tokamak_casing: Lead-lined shell for a fusion hall. Deuterium-tritium fusion sends out 14.1 MeV neutrons that pass through anything thin, so these walls are not.
block.theoreticalsciences.topological_tr: Changes a material's topology without changing its chemistry.
block.theoreticalsciences.toroidal_field: One of the D-shaped coils that ring a tokamak. Together they make the strong field running the long way round the torus, holding the plasma off the walls.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_c: A locker past every infinity the lesser caches count to. What it holds is not so much stored as asserted to exist.
