block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_g: Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_p: Transcendent Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Four plasma injectors fire into a coil-wrapped chamber hotter than a hypernova. Burns catalyst plasmas to forge metals whose properties are chosen rather than discovered.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_s: Rock that no longer remembers which universe formed it. It has the solid presence of stone but none of the expected minerals, and its surface shifts colour faintly with my mood.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendental: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Transcendental Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_ca: A casing built to hold infinities: aleph-null shards over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams.
block.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_co: A coil of hypernova alloy wound around an aleph-null shard over a cosmic neutronium coil, superconducting at room temperature. It carries a current that never quite finishes counting itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.transition_val: A valve that sends each state on to the next by fixed odds. It looks only at where things are, never at how they got there: the Markov property.
block.theoreticalsciences.turbomolecular: A pump whose rotor spins so fast that its blades knock gas molecules out of the chamber one by one. It whines at a pitch just below hearing. Ultra-high vacuum starts here.
block.theoreticalsciences.universe_forge: Triggers false-vacuum decay and cosmic inflation to grow - and later harvest - a pocket universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.unruh_accelera: A storage ring whose electrons are accelerated so hard round their curve that, to them, the empty vacuum is warm.
block.theoreticalsciences.unruh_detector: An accelerating detector should feel empty space as warm. It is a faint warmth: one kelvin takes an acceleration of some 10^20 metres per second squared.
block.theoreticalsciences.unruh_ring_cas: Casing for a ring of extreme acceleration. An accelerated observer finds warm thermal radiation where an inertial one sees empty vacuum: the Unruh effect.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_beam_pi: A pipe of containment field glass and metamaterial lined with Casimir plates, so the space inside is emptier than empty. A particle beam runs through it without touching anything at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_beam_tu: Steel tube pumped to ultra-high vacuum, so a laser crosses kilometres with no stray gas to jitter its phase. LIGO's arms hold nearly 10,000 m³ of it.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_energy_: Energy borrowed from the vacuum itself, stored with exotic matter to keep the books balanced. Inside, graviton crystal holds the field taut while a dark matter lens focuses it.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_harvest: Holds a bubble of false vacuum open in the Quantum Foam and catches the virtual particles that flicker through it. What it catches depends on where it stands and how it is tuned.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_state_p: A projector that changes what empty space is. Exotic matter in its core shifts the vacuum energy of the region it covers, so the field inside is a slightly different universe.
The sealed doughnut-shaped chamber of a tokamak, pumped below a billionth of an atmosphere before fuel is let in, so the plasma meets nothing but itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_gravit: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Graviton when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_monopo: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Monopole when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_photon: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Photon when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_quark_: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Quark when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks.lo: Void lattice cut into bricks - rigid blocks of nothing stacked with careful joints. The wall looks like a pattern of very clean holes in the world.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_sl: A slab of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_st: Stairs of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_wa: A wall of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_glass.lor: Glass as dark as the space it came from. Gravity bends light as a lens does, and a well-aligned mass draws a background source into a full Einstein ring.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_b: Void lattice shards compacted into a block - a crystal of empty sites that is rigid even though there is nothing in it. Looking at it feels like looking at a hole in the world with very clean edges.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_o: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 128. Gives Void Lattice Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_pillar.lo: A pillar of Void Lattice, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_tiles.lor: Void Lattice Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.warp_casing.lo: Hull plating for a warp field forge. An Alcubierre bubble would need negative energy density in its walls, which is what makes this casing exotic.
block.theoreticalsciences.warp_coil_ring: One ring of a warp coil. The Alcubierre metric demands negative energy density, which no ordinary matter can supply in bulk.
block.theoreticalsciences.warp_field_for: Shapes a bubble of flat space inside a wall of negative energy: contracted ahead, expanded behind.
Casing for a machine that stitches with entanglement. Two particles that share one state stay linked, however far apart the weave carries them.
block.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_emi: Runs a black hole backwards in time. Nothing can enter; everything comes out.
block.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_frame: A casing threaded with negative mass and exotic matter, the ingredients a traversable wormhole needs to keep its throat open.
block.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_proje: Opens a traversable wormhole to distant stars and drags their matter through.
block.theoreticalsciences.x_ray_diffract: X-rays scattered by a crystal's planes of atoms reinforce only at angles that fit the spacing between them. Find the angle, and you know the lattice - and how to cut it.
block.theoreticalsciences.xenoplasm.lore: Xenoplasm, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.xray_cabinet.l: A lead-lined, interlocked box that keeps X-rays in. Opening the door cuts the tube, so the only thing exposed is the sample.
block.theoreticalsciences.xray_tube.lore: Electrons slammed into a copper anode knock out inner electrons, and copper's sharp Kα X-ray line shines out as others fall in. Nearly all the rest ends as heat.
block.theoreticalsciences.zero_point_ext: Burns Casimir plates, exotic matter, metamaterial sheets, spin foam and mirror processors to pull energy out of the vacuum.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.gen: I am what your engine was made of: every law you broke apart to build it.
You took the universe to pieces. Do you understand any of them?
Why does a clock slow down? What is a measurement? How many infinities are there?
And why did you do it - to make, to know, or to be?
Come inside. Show me what you understand.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.pro: One last question. Everything depends on it.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.shi: It has closed itself into a proof. Answer at the pedestals.
Its Echo has been played back into being. Everything exists again.

Everything that has ever been known, written once. Creative mode only.
item.theoreticalsciences.alcubierre_coil: Contracts space ahead, expands it behind.
item.theoreticalsciences.aleph_null_shar: The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.
item.theoreticalsciences.aleph_one.lore: The next size of infinity after the countable one.
item.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega_spa: Calls a Alpha Omega into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.amethyst_singul: 16,384 amethyst shard, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.anchor_core.lor: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends.
item.theoreticalsciences.anchored_warp_b: A warp bubble tied to the place it was anchored. Used, it carries you back there and is spent.
item.theoreticalsciences.annihilation_co: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box.
item.theoreticalsciences.annihilator_spa: Calls a Annihilator into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.anomalous_strai: Stem cells exposed to a contained anomaly. Their checkpoints are failing one by one: no p53, no brakes, no reason to stop dividing.
item.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_catalog: Every kind of anomaly you have contained, what it can do, how far it can spread and how big the largest one will be. Most are small; a few are not.
item.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_specime: A sample of something that should not be, held in a quarantine field small enough to carry. It is still trying to get out.
item.theoreticalsciences.anticarbon_crys: Antidiamond. Four antibonds per anti-atom, as hard as diamond.
As soft, as dense and as noble as gold. Do not wear it.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihelium_nucl: Two antiprotons and two antineutrons. Our own detectors have glimpsed a handful; the Antiverse is full of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_ce: 1,000 mB of Antihydrogen - a gas, at 20 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_cr: Frozen antihydrogen: one antiproton, one positron, a few kelvin.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_wi: Calls a Antihydrogen Wisp into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Anti-iron, refined in levitation. Its surface never touches the mould.
item.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_pell: Held in a Penning trap. Do not let it touch anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_sing: 8,192 antimatter pellet, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.antiproton_bund: A few billion antiprotons, slowed from near light speed and held in a magnetic bottle.
item.theoreticalsciences.antiquark_shard: Confined anti-colour charge, chipped from a creature of the Antiverse.
item.theoreticalsciences.antisilicon_sha: Semiconductor of the Antiverse - its holes are positrons.

item.theoreticalsciences.apeiron_ingot.l: Anaximander's apeiron: the boundless stuff everything else is cut from. The ingot has edges only where you look.
item.theoreticalsciences.apochromatic_ob: Fluorite between two lenses of fused silica: three colours brought to exactly one focus, and the rest within a hair of it.
item.theoreticalsciences.apoptosis_trigg: A CRISPR-written instruction that only an anomalous cell will read: a reminder of the death it was always supposed to accept.
Water from a confined aquifer, tens of thousands of years old: rain from the last ice age, still on its way.
item.theoreticalsciences.arbor_heartwood: Wood from the World Tree. It is warm, cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once.
item.theoreticalsciences.arrow_of_time_s: Entropy only goes up - that is all "forward" means. This shard points the other way.
item.theoreticalsciences.assembly_matrix: The frame femtoscale parts are mounted on: the Femtoscale Assembly Line and the White Hole Emitter build with it.
Stores charge in the Higgs field itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.atto_inductor.l: Wound from a magnetic monopole's field lines.
item.theoreticalsciences.atto_transistor: Switches between superposed states before it is asked to.
item.theoreticalsciences.autocatalytic_b: 1,000 mB of Autocatalytic Broth - a liquid, at 320 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.autonomous_cali: Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax.
item.theoreticalsciences.avogadro_record: A thousand tracks of a clay grain in water, each one a staggering random walk, and from how far they wander: how many molecules make a mole. Perrin won the Nobel Prize for this.
A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_key.lore: Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_of_choice: From every set of sets you may pick one of each. Accept it and spheres can be doubled.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_schema.lo: The rules you agree to before you prove anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_sentinel_: Calls a Axiom Sentinel into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.banach_tarski_s: Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.
item.theoreticalsciences.baryogenesis_se: Out of equilibrium, violating baryon number, C and CP: the three conditions for a universe to end up made of something.
item.theoreticalsciences.baryon_asymmetr: One extra quark in every billion pairs. Everything that was not annihilated grew out of that one part in a billion.
item.theoreticalsciences.basaltic_magma_: 1,000 mB of Basaltic Magma - a liquid, at 1,450 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.beam_splitter.l: A disc of fused silica coated so it lets exactly half the light through and reflects the other half.
item.theoreticalsciences.bekenstein_crys: Holds the maximum information a region of space can contain.
item.theoreticalsciences.binary_serpent_: Two bodies coiled round each other in a tightening spiral, shedding gravitational waves. Each turn is faster than the last, until the chirp ends in a merger.
item.theoreticalsciences.biosphere_compe: One of every creature that can be eaten, pressed into one. Do not eat.
item.theoreticalsciences.bitter_plate.lo: A copper disc cut with a slit and pierced with cooling holes. Stacked into a helix, Bitter plates make the strongest steady magnets there are.
item.theoreticalsciences.black_swan_feat: Proof that the improbable happens. For centuries every swan was white - until one was not.
item.theoreticalsciences.black_swan_spaw: The rare, unforeseeable event, explained only afterwards. Europeans held every swan white until Dutch sailors met black ones in Australia in 1697; this one is seldom seen.
item.theoreticalsciences.blue_ice_singul: 8,192 blue ice, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.boltzmann_brain: A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. It is very confused.
Calls a Boltzmann Brain into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.boltzmann_fluct: Wait long enough in a universe at equilibrium and anything happens by chance. This is the anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.bootstrap_artif: Nobody made it. It was always handed back from the future.
item.theoreticalsciences.boron_control_r: Boron carbide in a steel sleeve. Boron-10 drinks neutrons: push the rod in and the chain reaction slows.
item.theoreticalsciences.bose_einstein_c: 1,000 mB of Bose-Einstein Condensate - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.bottom_top_quar: The third generation. The top quark weighs as much as a gold atom and decays before it can bind to anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.bounce_core.lor: A universe crushed to the Planck density, where the quantum geometry of space turned the collapse around.
item.theoreticalsciences.boundary_cft_ch: A quantum field theory without gravity, on a boundary - which is the same theory as gravity in the space inside it.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_shifter.l: Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_strider_s: Calls a Brane Strider into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_tension_f: A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.

item.theoreticalsciences.brownian_suspen: 1,000 mB of Brownian Suspension - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item.theoreticalsciences.calabi_yau_mani: Six compact dimensions, folded small enough to hold.

item.theoreticalsciences.car_t_culture.l: Killer T cells taught a new receptor: they hunt one marker, the anomaly's own, and they multiply as they find it.
item.theoreticalsciences.carbon_nanotube: Graphene rolled into tubes, the tubes twisted into rope.
item.theoreticalsciences.carborane_super: 1,000 mB of Carborane Superacid - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item.theoreticalsciences.casimir_plate.l: Two plates nanometres apart. The vacuum between them pushes.
item.theoreticalsciences.category_lattic: Objects and arrows, and nothing else. All of mathematics fits inside.
item.theoreticalsciences.causal_set_seed: Events scattered at random into spacetime, with nothing but which came before which. From that order alone, geometry grows.

item.theoreticalsciences.causal_solder_c: 1,000 mB of Causal Solder - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item.theoreticalsciences.cognitive_singu: Every thought that could be thought, compressed into one point.

item.theoreticalsciences.complex_plane.l: Real and imaginary at right angles. Every polynomial finally has its roots.

item.theoreticalsciences.computronium_si: 8,192 computronium ingot, crushed into one point.

item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_string_s: A one-dimensional defect from the early universe.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_web_fila: The largest structure there is: filaments of dark matter and gas a hundred million light-years long, with galaxies strung along them like dew on a web.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmological_co: Lambda: the energy of empty space that pushes the universe apart.

item.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_armo: Neutronium held at stellar-core pressure by a spacetime-alloy frame. Starlight does not dent it.
item.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_matt: Electron-degenerate matter from a dead star's core. Absurdly heavy.

item.theoreticalsciences.differential_ma: A space that is flat up close and curved far away - the stage on which relativity is written.

item.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_singu: 16,384 dilithium crystal, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_res: 1,000 mB of Dimensional Residue - a liquid, at 500 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_sin: All eleven dimensions, compressed into none.

item.theoreticalsciences.dynamic_singula: A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).

item.theoreticalsciences.dyson_swarm_sat: One of millions. Feed them to a Dyson Array.
item.theoreticalsciences.e8_lattice.lore: The densest way to pack spheres in eight dimensions.

item.theoreticalsciences.echo_lattice.lo: Echoes of the Transcendental, crossed and woven into a frame that remembers the shape of a world.
item.theoreticalsciences.eigenstate_latt: The states a measurement is allowed to find, and no others.
item.theoreticalsciences.einstein_field_: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.

item.theoreticalsciences.empty_set.lore: The set with nothing in it - made from the nothing a Void Wraith leaves behind.

item.theoreticalsciences.entropy_die.lor: A die worn perfectly fair. Every face is equally likely - which is to say it carries the most entropy a die can: log₂ 6 bits a throw.
Omega to the omega to the omega... forever. And still countable.
item.theoreticalsciences.equilibrium_lat: Forged with Omnipotence: a law that says this machine does not change. It does not.
item.theoreticalsciences.er_bridge_threa: Two entangled particles, and a wormhole too small to pass through joining them: Einstein-Rosen equals Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen.
item.theoreticalsciences.ergodic_mixer_c: A mixer that visits every state there is, given time - so its average over time is its average over all of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.error_correctio: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit, voting out every error.
item.theoreticalsciences.eschaton_cell.l: The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are.
item.theoreticalsciences.eschaton_core.l: The heart of every last thing. Forged by hand in the reborn Core - and once you have, the Eschaton Foundry can make more.
item.theoreticalsciences.eternity_cataly: A crystal that outlasts the universe. Some of the final processes only need it present; others use it up.
item.theoreticalsciences.euclidean_ancho: Euclid's fifth postulate, made to hold. Wherever its bearer stands, parallel lines stay parallel.
item.theoreticalsciences.evaporation_fla: Last Flash of a Black Hole
The final second of an evaporating black hole: hotter and brighter the smaller it gets, until nothing is left but the light.
item.theoreticalsciences.exoplanet_core_: Iron and nickel from the core of a planet that formed round another star, and was shattered in a collision long ago.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_crystal_: 8,192 exotic matter crystal, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_matter_c: 1,000 mB of Exotic Matter - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
Negative energy density. It tries to fall upward.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_matter_s: Negative mass, antimatter, strange matter and dark matter, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_solder_c: 1,000 mB of Exotic Solder - a liquid, at 1,200 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum_ce: 1,000 mB of False Vacuum - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum_me: The skin of a Vacuum Drifter: the wall between two vacua.
item.theoreticalsciences.faraday_cage_me: A fine copper mesh. Charges in it rearrange until the field inside is zero. Carried in the off hand, it shields you from Decoherence.
item.theoreticalsciences.faraday_isolato: A garnet crystal in a strong magnetic field turns the plane of polarised light - the same way whichever way the light goes. Light passes out; its reflection, turned twice, cannot pass back.
item.theoreticalsciences.femto_capacitor: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton.
A superconducting coil wound around nothing.
Iron oxide pressed with clay, fired, then magnetised: cheap, brittle and permanently magnetic.
item.theoreticalsciences.ferrofluid_cell: 1,000 mB of Ferrofluid - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.feynman_diagram: Every possible history, summed. Each line is a particle, each vertex an interaction.
item.theoreticalsciences.field_calibrato: Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value.
If information escapes a black hole, the entanglement across its horizon must break - and a broken horizon would burn whatever falls in. A shard of that hypothetical wall of fire.
item.theoreticalsciences.fission_fragmen: Caesium, strontium, iodine and xenon: what a uranium nucleus becomes when it splits. Two billion years ago, Oklo made this on its own.
item.theoreticalsciences.fission_husk_sp: A heavy, unstable shell of uranium-dark stone. It is always close to splitting, and when it goes it breaks into two lighter pieces and a burst of heat.
item.theoreticalsciences.fixed_point_lat: Gravity's strength, run to ever shorter distances, settles on a fixed value instead of blowing up: a theory safe all the way down.
item.theoreticalsciences.flerovium_ingot: Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons.
Calcium fluoride grown as one crystal. It bends colours apart less than any glass, so lenses of it bring every colour to one focus.
item.theoreticalsciences.fluorite_lens.l: A lens cut from a fluorite boule along its lattice. Paired with glass it cancels the colour error glass alone cannot.
item.theoreticalsciences.fluorspar.lore: Calcium fluoride, which grows in veins beside calcite. The fluorine that turns uranium into a gas comes from here.
item.theoreticalsciences.folded_protein_: A chain of amino acids that found its one shape out of more than the universe has atoms.
item.theoreticalsciences.form_of_the_sel: Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.
item.theoreticalsciences.formal_proof_tr: Every step justified, every axiom cited. Machines can check it; humans rarely can.
Any signal is a sum of waves. This one is a sum of all of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_core.lo: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_dust.lo: Self-similar grit from the Platonic Realm. Every grain contains smaller copies of the whole pile.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_set.lor: z → z² + c, iterated forever. Infinitely detailed at every scale.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_wyrm_sp: Calls a Fractal Wyrm into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractured_essen: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_b: Boots that pull you down where gravity is weak and hold you up where it is strong: you walk normally in the Asteroid Belt and the Pulsar Field.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_c: Layers of reflective foil round a coolant loop: the Accretion Rim's heat cannot set you alight.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_h: A visor that measures how the light reaching it is bent and unbends it: you see through nebular dust and the Lensing Void's warped sight lines, and a Nebuloid cannot blind you.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_l: A frame that takes the stretch for you: the Accretion Rim's tidal pull no longer strains you.
item.theoreticalsciences.frozen_photon.l: Light that reached the horizon and stopped there, red-shifted to nothing.
A rule that sends every input to exactly one output - drawn as a curve of light.
A map between categories that keeps every arrow pointing the right way.
item.theoreticalsciences.fused_silica.lo: Quartz melted in the Solar Furnace and cooled to a glass. It barely expands with heat, so a mirror made of it keeps its figure.
item.theoreticalsciences.fused_silica_le: A lens of fused silica, ground and polished to a quarter of a wavelength. Glass has no lattice: it needs no orientation to cut.
item.theoreticalsciences.fusion_blanket_: Lithium-6 behind lead and graphite. It catches the fusion neutrons, turns their energy into heat, and breeds tritium as it does.
item.theoreticalsciences.g2_manifold.lor: Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions.
item.theoreticalsciences.galactic_filame: A map of the hydrogen in a filament of gas feeding a galaxy - a thread of the cosmic web, at the scale of one galaxy.
item.theoreticalsciences.garnet.lore: Pyrope garnet, born where crust is dragged down and squeezed. Hard, dense and cheap: the grit of every cutting wheel.
item.theoreticalsciences.garnet_boule.lo: A synthetic garnet crystal, grown flawless. Garnets doped with rare earths are the heart of the most common solid-state lasers.
item.theoreticalsciences.gauge_boson_clu: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the carriers of every force except gravity.
item.theoreticalsciences.gauss_meter.lor: A Hall-effect probe: reads the magnetic field where you stand, from the planet's own to a magnet in your hand.
Held in either hand, it clicks for every decay it hears - from what you carry and from the ground around you.
item.theoreticalsciences.geiger_tube.lor: A thin wire in a tube of low-pressure gas at high voltage. One ionising particle and the whole tube avalanches into a click.
item.theoreticalsciences.gene_sampler.lo: Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples.
item.theoreticalsciences.general_ai_core: An artificial general intelligence. It asks good questions.
item.theoreticalsciences.genome_sample.l: Every instruction for building one creature, in a vial.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_anchor: Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm, the Antiverse, the Quantum Foam and the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_compas: A compass that points along the straightest path through curved spacetime - which is the path a falling body takes.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_thread: The straightest possible line - through curved spacetime.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodetic_survey: Triangulates the ground around you and lists the ores within 24 blocks, with the nearest of each.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodynamo_wrait: A drifting presence of churning iron and current, the geodynamo given shape. Like Earth's own field, it wanders, and now and then flips its poles.
item.theoreticalsciences.geoid_model.lor: The true shape of the planet: not a sphere, not quite an ellipsoid, but the surface the sea would take if it could flow everywhere.
item.theoreticalsciences.glowstone_singu: 32,768 glowstone dust, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.glueball_core.l: A particle made of nothing but the force carriers that hold quarks together.
"This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.
item.theoreticalsciences.gold_singularit: 16,384 gold ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.grand_unified_c: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.
Carbon one atom thick. Stronger than steel, conducts better than copper.
item.theoreticalsciences.graphite_modera: Nuclear-grade graphite. Carbon slows fission neutrons down without swallowing them, so they can split the next nucleus.
item.theoreticalsciences.gravitational_w: A ripple in spacetime from two merging black holes, caught and frozen mid-oscillation.
Faint repeats after a merger's ringdown - if a horizon is not quite a horizon, the waves bounce. Play it in the Accretion Frontier and something answers.
item.theoreticalsciences.gravitic_lens_e: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where you need it.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_crysta: Quantised gravity, frozen into a lattice. Feels heavier than it is.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_harnes: Spreads crushing gravity evenly through you. Carry it into high-gravity fields.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_wisp_c: The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of gravity that still pulls on your hand.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_wisp_s: Calls a Graviton Wisp into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.greaves_of_the_: Distance is a law. You may keep it or not.
item.theoreticalsciences.gw_record_bbh.l: A chirp a fifth of a second long: two black holes of thirty suns each spiralling together a billion light-years away.
item.theoreticalsciences.gw_record_bns.l: A minute-long chirp of two neutron stars colliding. Where they merged, gold and platinum were made - and a telescope can still see it glow.
item.theoreticalsciences.hafnium_178m2_i: A nucleus that holds 2.4 MeV in a high-spin state for thirty-one years: a gram of it stores as much as a tonne of TNT.
item.theoreticalsciences.hafnium_dust.lo: What is left when an isomer gives up its energy: ordinary hafnium.
item.theoreticalsciences.hall_bar_chip.l: A strip of two-dimensional electrons at a kelvin and ten tesla. Its Hall resistance sits on plateaus at exactly h/(νe²): a resistance standard set by nature.
item.theoreticalsciences.hamiltonian_ope: Ask it how a system changes and it answers with the energy.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_absorbe: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow a black hole gives off as it evaporates.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_emitter: Channels the thermal glow of an evaporating horizon.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_imp_spa: A small creature forever evaporating. Like a black hole, the smaller it gets the hotter it glows and the faster it radiates itself away.
The last light of a tiny black hole, caught as it evaporated. Hotter the smaller the hole was.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_radiati: 1,000 mB of Hawking Radiation - a gas, at 60 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
Phonon pairs straddling a sonic horizon, one on each side, correlated as Hawking said they must be: the glow of a horizon, seen.
item.theoreticalsciences.heat_death_embe: The last warmth of a universe going cold: a little above the temperature of its own horizon, and falling.
item.theoreticalsciences.heat_death_remn: All that is left of a universe at maximum entropy. Cold, even and perfectly still.
item.theoreticalsciences.heavy_radiation: Lead, graphite and boron carbide, which swallows the slowed neutrons. A plated piece stops 25% of the dose - four of them, all but 5%.
item.theoreticalsciences.heavy_water_cel: 1,000 mB of Heavy Water - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.heliostat_mirro: A flat silvered mirror on a two-axis mount that turns with the Sun, so its reflection stays on one spot all day.
item.theoreticalsciences.higgs_boson_cry: An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.
A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Spent in making spin foam, pulsar crystals and wormhole throats.
item.theoreticalsciences.higgs_field_cap: Stores a local excitation of the Higgs field. Handles mass.
item.theoreticalsciences.hilbert_bellhop: Calls a Hilbert Bellhop into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.holographic_mat: A 3D object stored entirely on its 2D boundary.
item.theoreticalsciences.holographic_scr: A surface that holds everything in the volume behind it, one bit per four Planck areas.
A 3-sphere unwound into circles, every two of them linked.
item.theoreticalsciences.horizon_diver.l: Crosses an event horizon - inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible.
item.theoreticalsciences.horizon_shard.l: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered.
item.theoreticalsciences.hotel_key.lore: Opens room n+1. There is always a room n+1.
item.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_line_m: A chart of the 21-centimetre glow of cold hydrogen across the Galaxy. The line's Doppler shift gives how fast each cloud moves.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypercube_drift: Calls a Hypercube Drifter into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.hyperdimensiona: A crystal that extends a little way into the fourth dimension.
A die that is larger on the inside.
Circuits laid out in four dimensions, folded flat.
A pearl that teleports to everywhere at once.
Tier IV processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist.
A wafer with more surface than its area allows.
item.theoreticalsciences.hyperlattice_fr: A scaffold folded through a fourth dimension, so a nine-by-nine assembly has room for its insides.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_alloy: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_plasm: 1,000 mB of Hypernova Plasma - a liquid, at 10,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.hyperon_crystal: Strange baryons locked into a lattice. The strangeness makes them heavier than they have any right to be.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypersphere_fra: A curved piece of a sphere with a 3-dimensional surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.ice_core.lore: A cylinder of ice drilled from a glacier. Every layer is a year of snow, and its trapped bubbles are samples of the air of that year.
item.theoreticalsciences.identity_kernel: The smallest thing that is still you. Carry it in the Transcendental.
Also shields you completely in every other dimension.
The square root of minus one, distilled from the imaginary mass of a tachyon.
item.theoreticalsciences.immortal_cell_l: Telomerase switched back on: the chromosome ends rebuild themselves, and the cells forget how to grow old. They have outlived their donor.
item.theoreticalsciences.inaccessible_ca: An infinity so large nothing smaller can build it.
Cancels momentum locally. Standard issue on every starship.
item.theoreticalsciences.infinitesimal.l: Smaller than every positive number, yet not zero.
item.theoreticalsciences.inflaton_conden: A scalar field held at the top of its potential, rolling so slowly that space doubles many times before it moves.
item.theoreticalsciences.inflaton_field_: 1,000 mB of Inflaton Field - a gas, at 100,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.integer_ring.lo: The naturals, plus their antimatter reflections: every number now has a negative.
item.theoreticalsciences.integral_operat: The area under a curve, summed from infinitely many infinitesimal slices.
item.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_du: Grains of silicate and soot a tenth of a micron across, coated in ice. A hundredth of the interstellar medium by mass - and what every rocky planet was made of.
item.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_me: 1,000 mB of Interstellar Medium - a gas, at 8,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.ionic_liquid_ce: 1,000 mB of Ionic Liquid - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.iron_singularit: 16,384 iron ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.island_fragment: A region inside the horizon that belongs, after the Page time, to the radiation outside: the island that makes the curve turn over.
item.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_sh: Momentum around a fifth dimension curled up too small to see. Mined in the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_si: 16,384 kaluza klein shard, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.kerr_metric_sha: The exact geometry around a spinning black hole - ergosphere and all.
item.theoreticalsciences.kilonova_ash.lo: Gold, platinum and lanthanides made in a second by the rapid neutron capture of a neutron-star merger, and thrown out at a fifth of the speed of light.
item.theoreticalsciences.klein_bottle.lo: A bottle with no inside. It only fits together in four dimensions.
item.theoreticalsciences.kugelblitz_seed: Enough focused light to collapse on itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.lapis_singulari: 32,768 lapis lazuli, crushed into one point.
An intellect that knows every force and every position. Shown a machine, it knows exactly how the machine must be run.
item.theoreticalsciences.large_deviation: A record of something that was not supposed to happen - and the exponentially small odds it beat.
item.theoreticalsciences.laser_head.lore: A laser rod between two mirrors, pumped by a flash of light, behind a Faraday isolator so no reflection can come back into it. A single frequency, steady for hours.
item.theoreticalsciences.laser_rod.lore: Garnet doped with neodymium, cut along its lattice and polished flat at both ends. Pumped with light, it gives back more light than it took in, all of one colour: infrared at 1064 nanometres.
item.theoreticalsciences.lattice_seed.lo: A flawless crystal nucleus. Boules grow from it atom by atom.
item.theoreticalsciences.laue_pattern.lo: A photographic plate exposed to X-rays scattered by a crystal: a pattern of spots that shows how its lattice planes lie. Cut along them.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_crystal.lor: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_violation_s: A sliver of space where a conservation law quietly fails: charge appears from nothing, and the rest of physics has to make room.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_wraith_spaw: Calls a Law Wraith into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.lawgivers_codex: Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.
item.theoreticalsciences.lead_shielding_: Dense, soft and cheap. Each centimetre of lead halves a gamma ray's chance of getting through.
item.theoreticalsciences.lens_phantom_sp: Nearly invisible: it is seen only by how it bends the light behind it into arcs and rings, the way unseen dark matter betrays itself to telescopes.
item.theoreticalsciences.lense_thirring_: A knot of spacetime twisted round by a spinning mass: anything near it is dragged round with it.
Electron, muon and tau - with a neutrino shadowing each.
item.theoreticalsciences.light_radiation: Lead plate shaped to fit armour. Put it with any armour piece in a crafting grid: that piece then stops 10% of the radiation dose.
item.theoreticalsciences.light_sail.lore: A sail of aluminised film a few microns thick, pushed by nothing but the pressure of starlight. Unfurl it high above the world, where there is no air left to drag on it, and it carries you out to the Accretion Frontier.
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_antiheli: 1,000 mB of Liquid Antihelium - a liquid, at 2 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_sodium_c: 1,000 mB of Liquid Sodium - a liquid, at 600 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_spacetim: 1,000 mB of Liquid Spacetime - a liquid, at 3 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.lithium_6_ingot: Lithium enriched in its lighter isotope. One neutron splits it into helium and tritium - which is how a fusion blanket breeds its fuel.
item.theoreticalsciences.lithium_ingot.l: The lightest metal, won from brine. Soft enough to cut with a knife; it floats on oil and burns crimson.
item.theoreticalsciences.lithospheric_pl: Rock from the base of a tectonic plate, where the cold, rigid lithosphere rides on the soft mantle below.
item.theoreticalsciences.litz_wire.lore: Hundreds of thin copper strands, each insulated and woven so every one takes its turn at the outside: at high frequency current crowds to a wire's skin, and this gives it more skin.
item.theoreticalsciences.logos_thread.lo: A strand of the Word that orders the world. Wound into a coil it makes space obey a shape.
item.theoreticalsciences.lonsdaleite.lor: Hexagonal diamond, made only in the shock of an impact - harder, in places, than diamond itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.lorentz_transfo: Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c.
item.theoreticalsciences.m_brane.lore: A two-dimensional membrane of M-theory. Whole universes can live on one.
item.theoreticalsciences.m_theory_core.l: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.
item.theoreticalsciences.magma_crawler_s: Calls a Magma Crawler into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetar_crust_: Iron crust from a magnetar, under a field of 10¹¹ tesla. It cracks in starquakes - and it still bends compass needles from across a room.
Its magnetic field would wipe a credit card from the Moon.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_monopo: A north pole with no south. Dirac would be pleased.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetite.lore: Fe₃O₄, the most magnetic mineral there is. Struck by lightning it becomes lodestone; ground up it becomes ferrite.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetized_plas: 1,000 mB of Magnetized Plasma - a gas, at 1,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.mantle_of_omnip: Harm needs a law to happen by. You are wearing all of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.markov_chain_li: A link that remembers only the one before it. Chain enough of them and the past stops mattering at all.
The Higgs field has been told to ignore it.
item.theoreticalsciences.mathematics_sin: Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_boltzma: 1,000 mB of Maxwell-Boltzmann Gas - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_demon_c: A tiny intelligence that opens a door for fast molecules only. Thermodynamics objects.
item.theoreticalsciences.medium_radiatio: Lead backed with graphite, which slows the neutrons lead lets through. A plated piece stops 18% of the dose.
What is left when two compact stars become one: a single spinning hole, ringing down to stillness.
item.theoreticalsciences.metal_organic_f: Metal nodes, organic struts: a sponge with more inner surface than a football pitch per gram.
item.theoreticalsciences.metallic_hydrog: 1,000 mB of Liquid Metallic Hydrogen - a liquid, at 20 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.
item.theoreticalsciences.metamaterial_sh: Negative refractive index. Light bends the wrong way.
item.theoreticalsciences.metamorphic_sch: Basalt pressed and baked until its minerals regrew as flat, glittering mica - with the odd red garnet among them.
item.theoreticalsciences.metastable_vacu: The Higgs potential mapped out to the Planck scale: the valley we live in is not the deepest one. Held in a lattice of Higgs field capacitors.
item.theoreticalsciences.metastatic_spor: A cluster of cells that has learned to leave: to slip its tissue, ride the blood and grow again somewhere it was never meant to be.
item.theoreticalsciences.meteoric_iron.l: Iron and nickel from the core of a planetesimal that shattered billions of years ago. Etched, it shows crossed plates that grew only a degree in a million years.
item.theoreticalsciences.metric_tensor.l: g_μν: the rule for measuring distance in curved spacetime.
item.theoreticalsciences.micro_singulari: A black hole the mass of a mountain, smaller than an atom.
item.theoreticalsciences.microenvironmen: An anomaly is never alone: here it has grown its own blood vessels, recruited its own stroma and taught the local immune cells to look away.
item.theoreticalsciences.minkowski_latti: Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_alloy_in: Matter and antimatter in alternating grains, a Penning field between every pair. It hums.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_processo: Antisilicon logic on an anticarbon die: it computes with positrons.
item.theoreticalsciences.mobius_strip.lo: One side, one edge. Walk along it and you come back upside down.
item.theoreticalsciences.mod_essence_cel: 1,000 mB of Mod Essence - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.modular_form.lo: A function so symmetric it is called "the fifth fundamental operation of arithmetic".
item.theoreticalsciences.moduli_crawler_: Calls a Moduli Crawler into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
The shape and size of the hidden dimensions, crystallised. Found in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite.lore: Silicon carbide, found in nature only in a few meteorites and in mantle rock. Harder than any gem but diamond, and far tougher: a drill bit of it cuts iron.
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite_dril: A moissanite-tipped drill on a netherite shank: it mines Iron-Nickel and Core Magnetite Ore, which nothing softer can.
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite_lens: Silicon carbide bends light more than diamond does: a moissanite lens is strong for its thickness, and it fires rainbows.
item.theoreticalsciences.molecular_cloud: 1,000 mB of Molecular Cloud - a gas, at 15 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.molecular_orbit: Electron wavefunctions shared between atoms, frozen into a grid. This is what a chemical bond is.
item.theoreticalsciences.molten_salt_fue: 1,000 mB of Molten Salt Fuel - a liquid, at 900 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.monazite_sand.l: Heavy golden grains sorted out of beach sand: a phosphate of the rare earths, with a little thorium that keeps it faintly radioactive.
item.theoreticalsciences.monte_carlo_sam: A billion random points, drawn and sorted: the answer to an integral too hard to do any other way, to a part in thirty thousand.
item.theoreticalsciences.morphogenic_ser: Every signal an embryo listens to, in one vial. A Breached Anomaly Engine spends one on every creature it grows.
item.theoreticalsciences.mu_metal_shield: Four parts nickel to one of iron, annealed in hydrogen: so permeable that a magnetic field would rather run through it than past what it shields. Carried in the off hand, it keeps you from being Magnetized.
item.theoreticalsciences.multiverse_shar: Matter from a universe with slightly different constants. Its colour will not settle.
item.theoreticalsciences.muonic_catalyst: Swap an electron for a muon and atoms shrink 200 times - close enough to fuse cold.
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_slurry_c: 1,000 mB of Nanite Slurry - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_swarm.lo: A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_swarm_sp: Calls a Nanite Swarm into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Superhuman at one thing; useless at everything else.
item.theoreticalsciences.natural_number_: One, two, three... Peano built all of arithmetic from zero and "the next one".
item.theoreticalsciences.nebular_gas_cel: 1,000 mB of Nebular Gas - a gas, at 40 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.nebuloid_spawn_: Calls a Nebuloid into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.negative_energy: Casimir cavities stacked by the million: in each, the vacuum between the plates holds less energy than the vacuum outside.
item.theoreticalsciences.negative_mass_i: Push it and it comes toward you.
item.theoreticalsciences.negentropy_cell: Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside.
item.theoreticalsciences.neodymium_blank: Nd₂Fe₁₄B, cast and pressed, not yet magnetised. Its crystals all point the same way, waiting for a field strong enough to set them.
item.theoreticalsciences.neodymium_magne: The strongest permanent magnet known: a thumb-sized piece can hold a kilogram of steel. Loses its strength above about 80 °C.
item.theoreticalsciences.netherite_singu: 2,048 netherite ingot, crushed into one point.
Billions of photonic neurons in a self-organising mesh.
item.theoreticalsciences.neural_organoid: A pea-sized brain grown in a dish. It has started to dream.
item.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_flux_c: 1,000 mB of Neutrino Flux - a gas, at 10 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_plat: Rolled to a thickness of a few femtometres.
item.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_sing: 32,768 neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.no_boundary_see: A closed universe tunnelled from nothing: round, without an edge, and without a first moment of time.
item.theoreticalsciences.noble_gas_clath: Xenon caged in ice. The noble gases are not as aloof as the textbooks said.
item.theoreticalsciences.normal_distribu: Faceted where the bell curve says it should be: most of it near the middle, less and less towards the edges, none past the tails.
item.theoreticalsciences.novikov_crystal: The self-consistency principle, crystallised: any time loop it is part of has no paradoxes.
item.theoreticalsciences.nuclear_waste_g: Fission products melted into borosilicate glass: it will hold them for the hundred thousand years they need.
item.theoreticalsciences.nutrient_broth_: 1,000 mB of Nutrient Broth - a liquid, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.ocean_simulacru: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.
item.theoreticalsciences.octonion_crysta: Eight dimensions, and multiplication no longer associates. The largest number system that still divides.
item.theoreticalsciences.omega_one.lore: The first ordinal that cannot be counted.
item.theoreticalsciences.omega_ordinal.l: The first number after all of the counting numbers.
item.theoreticalsciences.omega_point.lor: The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnicellular_ge: One genome that can build any creature in any dimension.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnilex.lore: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_seal.lo: A wax seal pressed with a law. Machines that bear one are permitted to work.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_dus: Ground Omnipotence. Each grain can still be anything - for a moment.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_see: Everything a Core needs to grow, folded small: a heart, a remembered world, and the proof that it can be done.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_sha: A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how - it has only forgotten what.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotent_edge: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotent_ingo: Metal that is whatever metal it needs to be. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.
item.theoreticalsciences.omniscience_cat: Every singularity there is, fused around a Theory of Everything. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnium_ingot.lo: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnium_singular: Two hundred and fifty-six Omnium Ingots in one point. There is nothing left to compress it into.
item.theoreticalsciences.ontological_jun: Where a machine's idea of itself meets its matter. Without one, big machines forget what they are for.
item.theoreticalsciences.ontological_pro: Tier VI processor. It does not compute answers - it decides what is true.
item.theoreticalsciences.oracle_lemma.lo: Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.
item.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_hound_s: Calls a Ordinal Hound into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_shard.l: A piece of the order in which infinities come.
item.theoreticalsciences.page_curve_reco: The entropy of a black hole's radiation: rising as it evaporates, until halfway - then falling back to zero. Information comes out. Carried in the off hand, it puts your hotbar back in order (no Information Loss).
item.theoreticalsciences.panspermia_seed: Life packed to survive the trip between universes.
item.theoreticalsciences.paradox_echo_sp: A figure forever meeting its own past. It acts out the grandfather paradox, flickering whenever its history stops adding up.
item.theoreticalsciences.paradox_residue: What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.partition_funct: Z = Σ e^(−E/kT), summed over every state a system can be in. Everything else - energy, entropy, pressure - is a derivative of it.
item.theoreticalsciences.path_integral.l: Every way of getting from here to there, added up.
item.theoreticalsciences.penning_harness: A wearable Penning trap: magnetic and electric fields that keep every atom of you from touching the Antiverse.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm.
item.theoreticalsciences.penrose_spindle: Couples to a rotating horizon's ergosphere.
item.theoreticalsciences.pentaquark_shar: Five quarks bound into one exotic hadron. They only exist for an instant - unless you crystallise them.
item.theoreticalsciences.penteract_latti: A five-dimensional cube: 32 corners, 80 edges, 40 cells.
item.theoreticalsciences.perfect_crystal: Three slabs cut from one silicon crystal, still joined at the base, so their lattice planes line up to a fraction of an atom: they split a neutron's wave, steer it, and bring it back together.
item.theoreticalsciences.peridot.lore: Gem olivine, the mineral the upper mantle is mostly made of. It forms only deep down and only reaches the surface carried up in lava.
item.theoreticalsciences.permafrost_samp: Soil frozen for thousands of years, holding the carbon of the plants that grew before it froze.
item.theoreticalsciences.phantom_energy_: Dark energy with w below -1. Its density grows as space expands, until it tears apart galaxies, stars, atoms - and then the cell.
item.theoreticalsciences.phase_locked_st: Locks a multiblock's fields to a reference oscillator. Drift comes slower and smaller.
item.theoreticalsciences.photographic_pl: A glass plate coated with a light-sensitive emulsion set in gelatin. Left open under the sky for an hour, it records stars far too faint for any eye.
item.theoreticalsciences.photon_moth_spa: Calls a Photon Moth into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_lens.l: Focuses light onto wafers: never used up in lithography, though many finer optics are built from it.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_logic_: Engraved with waveguides instead of wires.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_neuron: A neuron that thinks at the speed of light.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_proces: Tier I processor. Computes with light.
item.theoreticalsciences.photoresist_cel: 1,000 mB of Quantum-Dot Photoresist - a liquid, at 290 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.pixel_tracker_m: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_area_til: The smallest area there is, in loop quantum gravity: 8πγℓₚ²√(j(j+1)), where a spin network's link pierces a surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_diver.lo: Shrinks you past the Planck length into the Quantum Foam. Use again to come back.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_mite_spa: Calls a Planck Mite into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_shard.lo: 1.6 x 10^-35 m. You cannot cut it smaller.
item.theoreticalsciences.planetary_core_: Iron and nickel from two planets' cores, pressed together to the pressure at a core's centre: the stuff every rocky planet sinks to its middle.
item.theoreticalsciences.planetary_nebul: The glowing shell a dying Sun-like star throws off: oxygen green, hydrogen red, round a white dwarf at its centre.
item.theoreticalsciences.planetary_plate: The sharpest of a thousand short exposures of a planet, taken in the instants the air held still: belts, moons, a shadow.
item.theoreticalsciences.plasma_nozzle_t: A converging magnetic nozzle that accelerates plasma to a few percent of light speed.
item.theoreticalsciences.plasma_thruster: A magnetic nozzle of lonsdaleite and iron: plasma pushed out along its field lines leaves faster than any chemical exhaust.
item.theoreticalsciences.platonic_compas: Points at the realm of ideal forms - and, used, takes you there (and back).
item.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_cell.lo: 1,000 mB of Pleroma - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_crystal: Pleroma - the fullness. Every law the Transcendental held, frozen into one lattice.
item.theoreticalsciences.plume_elemental: A column of hot rock rising from the base of the mantle, solid yet flowing over the ages. Where such a plume reaches the crust, chains of volcanoes follow.
item.theoreticalsciences.plutonium_239_p: Bred from uranium-238 in the reactor and taken out of its spent salt. Warm to the touch from its own alpha decay.
item.theoreticalsciences.pocket_universe: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble you can hold. Please do not drop it.
item.theoreticalsciences.poisson_clock.l: A clock that ticks at random: each tick a decay in its radium, the waits between them falling off exponentially. It keeps perfect average time and never says when.
item.theoreticalsciences.polonium_210_so: A speck of polonium giving off so many alpha particles that it is warm to the touch. Harmless at arm's length; deadly inside you.
item.theoreticalsciences.positronium_hyd: A molecule made of a hydrogen atom and an atom of matter bound to antimatter. It lasts a nanosecond - unless you trap it.
item.theoreticalsciences.positronium_ski: Calls a Positronium Skitterer into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.posterior_table: Belief, updated by evidence. Carry one while solving a research derivation and it pays for a hint instead of Insight.
item.theoreticalsciences.power_set.lore: The set of all subsets. Always strictly bigger than what you started with.
item.theoreticalsciences.precision_gyros: A fused-quartz sphere, the roundest object ever made, spinning in a vacuum. Space itself turns its axis. Carried in the off hand, it holds you steady against Frame Drag and Tidal Strain.
item.theoreticalsciences.predictive_latt: Simulates the machine a minute ahead and corrects what has not happened yet.
item.theoreticalsciences.presolar_grains: Silicon carbide stardust condensed in the winds of stars that died before the Sun was born. Moissan named the mineral moissanite when he found it in a meteorite.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_b: Sealed boots of a pressure suit. Above about 19 km, the Armstrong limit, water boils at body temperature, and so would the wearer without them.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_c: A rigid shell built to bear the weight of rock overhead. At the base of Earth's mantle the pressure reaches about 136 GPa, over a million atmospheres.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_h: A sealed helmet that keeps the head in breathable pressure. Above about 19 km, water in the body would boil at body temperature without it.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_l: Layered leggings that hold air pressure against the body. Bending a knee in an inflated suit is hard work, so the joints are built to keep their volume constant.
item.theoreticalsciences.prime_shard.lor: Divisible only by itself and one. Grows naturally in the Platonic Realm; otherwise it has to be sieved out.
item.theoreticalsciences.prime_singulari: 16,384 prime shard, crushed into one point.
What the first three minutes made: three parts hydrogen to one of helium-4, a pinch of deuterium and helium-3, a trace of lithium-7.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_char: A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm, the Antiverse, the Quantum Foam, the Bulk, black and white holes and the Transfinite Hierarchy.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_ejec: Matter a white hole threw out before there was anything to throw.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_harv: Every crop that has ever grown, in one seed.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_law_: 1,000 mB of Primordial Law - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_soup: 1,000 mB of Primordial Soup - a liquid, at 340 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.prion_lattice.l: Misfolded protein stacked into amyloid. Touch a healthy protein to it and the healthy one misfolds too: shape is the infection.
item.theoreticalsciences.prior_tablet.lo: What you believe before you look, written down so that the evidence can change it.
item.theoreticalsciences.programmable_ma: Matter that changes its own shape and properties on command.
Part of a proof an Axiom Sentinel was writing about you. QED.
item.theoreticalsciences.proof_mass.lore: A polished cube of gold and platinum that touches nothing. Whatever path it follows is the path of free fall itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.proof_of_everyt: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.
item.theoreticalsciences.proton_decay_re: Positrons and neutral pions from protons that lived 10^34 years and then simply came apart.
A collapsing knot of nebular gas, hot enough to glow but not yet to fuse.
item.theoreticalsciences.protostellar_em: A shard of a star not yet lit, still glowing with the heat of its own collapse. A furnace of a fuel: it burns for a long time.
item.theoreticalsciences.prussian_blue_t: Iron hexacyanoferrate. Swallowed, it traps radioactive caesium and thallium in the gut so the body passes them instead of keeping them.
item.theoreticalsciences.psionic_ether_c: 1,000 mB of Psionic Ether - a gas, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_timing_c: Ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar.
item.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_timing_r: Arrival times of a pulsar's pulses, steady to a millionth of a second over months: a clock spun up in a dead star.
item.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_wisp_spa: A spinning wisp that flashes on a perfect beat, like the lighthouse beam of a pulsar. Millisecond pulsars keep time nearly as well as atomic clocks.
item.theoreticalsciences.quadrupole_pole: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres. Four of them squeeze a beam into focus.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_chlorop: Photosynthesis moves energy by trying every path at once - coherently.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_dot.lor: An artificial atom; its colour is set by its size.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_field_l: Particles are only ripples. The field is what is real.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_process: A fault-tolerant array of logical qubits.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_singula: Every possible state at once, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_spaceti: 1,000 mB of Quantum Spacetime Condensate - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
A one-dimensional vibrating string. Its mode of vibration decides which particle it is.
item.theoreticalsciences.quarantine_fiel: A field that clears an anomaly faster than it can copy itself. It does not destroy anything - it only keeps R below one.
item.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_pla: 1,000 mB of Quark-Gluon Plasma - a liquid, at 4,000,000,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.quark_star_core: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons.
item.theoreticalsciences.quasar_jet_fila: A thread of the jet that a spinning black hole drives out along its axis at nearly the speed of light, wound up in magnetic field.
item.theoreticalsciences.quaternion_crys: Hamilton carved i² = j² = k² = ijk = -1 into a bridge. Here it is carved into a crystal: pure rotation.
item.theoreticalsciences.qubit.lore: |0> and |1> at once, until you look.
item.theoreticalsciences.qubit_array_waf: Thousands of qubits, engraved through a metamaterial lens.
item.theoreticalsciences.qubit_die.lore: A single die of entangled qubits.
item.theoreticalsciences.quine_replicato: A machine whose instructions contain a description of itself and an order to copy it. A von Neumann replicator, a virus, a meme.
item.theoreticalsciences.r_process_clust: Gold, platinum and uranium, forged in seconds by the neutron flood of a supernova.
item.theoreticalsciences.radiogenic_lead: Lead that was once uranium, radium and radon: the stable end of a decay chain, made one nucleus at a time.
item.theoreticalsciences.radium_salt.lor: Ten milligrams of radium chloride, glowing faintly in the dark by its own decay. Handle it as little as you can.
item.theoreticalsciences.radon_cell.lore: 1,000 mB of Radon-222 - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.rail_armature.l: A copper slug that bridges a railgun's two rails: the current through it and the field of the rails push it out at kilometres a second.
item.theoreticalsciences.random_number_c: Single photons meet a half-silvered mirror: transmitted is 1, reflected is 0. Nothing in the universe knows the next bit in advance.
item.theoreticalsciences.random_walker_s: Calls a Random Walker into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.rare_earth_oxid: Neodymium, samarium and their cousins, so alike chemically that it took a century and a spectroscope to tell them apart.
Every ratio of integers. Dense everywhere - and still full of holes.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_antigold.lo: Gold of the mirror universe, cold blue where ours is warm yellow - only the light it reflects is the same.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_antiiron.lo: Ore from the Antiverse. Iron, exactly - except that every particle in it is the opposite one.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_pitchblende: Uraninite: heavy, black and pitch-glossy. Marie and Pierre Curie found two new elements in it by following its radioactivity.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_star_matter: 1,000 mB of Raw Star Matter - a liquid, at 15,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
The rationals with every gap filled - including the transcendental numbers mined from the Platonic Realm.
Keeps a patch of reality from being edited.
item.theoreticalsciences.recombinant_dna: A double helix spliced from more than one creature.
item.theoreticalsciences.red_giant_envel: The swollen outer layers of a dying star, a hundred times wider than it once was.
item.theoreticalsciences.redshift_lens.l: A calibrated lens of spectra: distances from standard candles set against the redshifts of their galaxies. Every one is moving away, and the farther, the faster.
item.theoreticalsciences.redshift_record: Counts of gamma rays climbing a tower, and the source speed that brought them back into tune: gravity measured with a stopwatch of atomic nuclei.
item.theoreticalsciences.refractory_suit: Boots lined with refractory ceramic, the kind that keeps its strength at temperatures that melt steel and lets very little of the heat through.
Armour of refractory ceramics, which keep their strength where metals soften. Basaltic magma erupts at about 1,100 to 1,200 °C, and the suit hardly notices.
A helmet lined with ceramic that shrugs off heat which would melt steel. It insulates, so the inside stays cool while the outside glows.
Leggings of ceramic fibre under aluminised cloth, like a furnace worker's. The bright outer layer reflects radiant heat before it can soak in.
item.theoreticalsciences.reheating_plasm: 1,000 mB of Reheating Plasma - a liquid, at 1,000,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.rekindled_heart: Four sparks of the second creation, beating together around an Eschaton Core.
item.theoreticalsciences.rekindled_spark: What the Pleroma Reconstitutor leaves behind once the Transcendental is whole again: the first light of the second creation.
item.theoreticalsciences.relativity_brea: 1,000 mB of Relativity Breakdown - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.renormalised_es: 1,000 mB of Renormalised Essence - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.residual_starli: 1,000 mB of Residual Starlight - a gas, at 50,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.resistant_clone: The cells that survived the last treatment - and so the ones that make the next tumour. Selection, not malice.
item.theoreticalsciences.resolved_anomal: An anomaly explained: its strangeness measured, renormalised, and written back into the laws. It is just physics now. It always was.
item.theoreticalsciences.resonance_probe: Reads the four virtual-particle resonances where you stand in the Quantum Foam.
item.theoreticalsciences.retrocausal_cry: It formed after you mined it.
item.theoreticalsciences.rf_resonator_ce: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. The standing wave inside kicks each passing bunch forward.
item.theoreticalsciences.rich_copper_chu: Porphyry copper, veined with gold that came up with it.
item.theoreticalsciences.rich_gold_chunk: Reef gold in quartz pebbles - the kind of ore that, on Earth, carries uraninite too.
item.theoreticalsciences.rich_iron_chunk: Banded iron from deep down: richer than any Overworld ore, with magnetite in its layers.
item.theoreticalsciences.riemann_curvatu: How much a vector turns when carried around a small loop - curvature itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.riemann_zeta_cr: Every non-trivial zero lies on the critical line. Probably. This crystal grew along it.
item.theoreticalsciences.rift_anchor.lor: Pins a tear between universes open long enough to reach through.
item.theoreticalsciences.ringwoodite.lor: A high-pressure form of olivine from 520 km down. Its crystals hold water: there may be more of it in the mantle than in every ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.room_temperatur: Zero resistance without cryogenics. Physicists have chased this for a century.
item.theoreticalsciences.russell_paradox: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?
item.theoreticalsciences.samarium_cobalt: Sm₂(Co,Fe,Cu)₁₇: harder to magnetise than neodymium, and it keeps its magnetism far hotter.
A little weaker than neodymium, but it keeps its field up to 300 °C - the magnet for hot machines.
A single crystal of aluminium oxide pulled from the melt, every atom of it in one lattice. Cut, it gives windows clear from ultraviolet to infrared.
item.theoreticalsciences.sapphire_window: A disc of synthetic sapphire, aluminium oxide grown from the melt: hard, clear from ultraviolet to infrared, and it stays clear when frozen.
item.theoreticalsciences.satellite_image: The ground seen from orbit, in visible and infrared: rivers, faults, and the heat of what lies under the surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.schmidt_correct: A thin, almost flat plate of fused silica, figured to a gentle aspheric curve. In front of a spherical mirror it gives a sharp image across a field many degrees wide.
item.theoreticalsciences.schrodinger_lim: 1,000 mB of Schrödinger's Limit - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.scintillator_cr: Flashes when a particle passes through it. Count the flashes and you know what was made in the collision.
item.theoreticalsciences.sediment_core.l: A tube of layered ground. Each band is a year, a flood or an ash fall, stacked in the order it happened.
item.theoreticalsciences.seismic_recorde: A paper drum turned by clockwork under a hanging pen. The ground shakes, the pen does not, and the difference is written down.
item.theoreticalsciences.self_healing_po: Cut it and the chains find each other again.
item.theoreticalsciences.silicon_boule.l: Silicon reduced from silica with carbon, then pulled from its melt as one flawless crystal: the most perfect solid people make.
item.theoreticalsciences.silicon_life_sp: Life built on silicon instead of carbon. It grew in the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.simulated_unive: A whole other world, run from its first instant to its last inside the Forge. Each mod has its own.
item.theoreticalsciences.singularity_clu: Nine singularities condensed into one, when there are too many to hold.
item.theoreticalsciences.singularity_sce: It does not fire singularities. It decides where one has always been.
item.theoreticalsciences.soft_hair_filam: Zero-energy excitations on a horizon that remember what fell in: a black hole may not be quite as bald as it seems.
item.theoreticalsciences.solar_statite.l: A light sail balanced between gravity and radiation pressure.
item.theoreticalsciences.source_code_fra: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_alloy: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.
8,192 spacetime alloy ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_beari: Turns on a frictionless geodesic. It will outlast the machine around it.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_catal: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) to grow pocket universes and the highest processors.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_singu: All of relativity, compressed into the one place relativity breaks down.
Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it.
item.theoreticalsciences.spark_of_life.l: The moment chemistry became biology, caught and kept.
item.theoreticalsciences.specimen_bundle: One of everything a mod's world grows or leaves behind, sealed in glass.
item.theoreticalsciences.spectral_analyz: Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight.
Starlight spread into a rainbow and caught on glass. The dark lines in it say which elements the light passed through.
A fuel rod after three years in a reactor: still mostly uranium, but laced with fission products a million times more radioactive.
item.theoreticalsciences.spent_fuel_salt: 1,000 mB of Spent Fuel Salt - a liquid, at 900 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.spin_foam_latti: Loop quantum gravity: spacetime itself, woven from discrete quanta of area.
item.theoreticalsciences.spin_network_no: A node of a spin network: a grain of volume, its faces the links that join it to its neighbours. Space is built from these.
Turn it through 360 degrees and it comes back negative. It takes 720 to restore it.
item.theoreticalsciences.stabiliser_matr: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load.
item.theoreticalsciences.standard_model_: Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.
Every particle that exists, compressed into one point.

item.theoreticalsciences.supernova_remna: What is left after a star's core collapses and its outer layers are blasted across the galaxy.
