item.theoreticalsciences.synaptic_fluid_: 1,000 mB of Synaptic Fluid - a liquid, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
The smallest genome that can still be alive, written from scratch.
item.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_flux_ce: 1,000 mB of Tachyon Flux - a gas, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_singula: 8,192 tachyon crystal, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.tardigrade_cult: Survives vacuum, radiation and freezing by simply pausing being alive.
item.theoreticalsciences.technetium_99m_: An excited nucleus that gives off one clean gamma ray and calms down within hours: the most used medical isotope in the world.
item.theoreticalsciences.telescope_mirro: A disc of glass ground to a paraboloid within a fraction of a wavelength, then silvered. Light from a whole star lands on one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.telomerase_comp: Rebuilds the clocks at the ends of chromosomes. Cells that have it do not age.
item.theoreticalsciences.temporal_knot.l: A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice.
item.theoreticalsciences.temporal_singul: Every moment there has ever been, compressed into one instant.

Focuses light through the fourth dimension. A lithography catalyst.
item.theoreticalsciences.test_mass.lore: Forty kilograms of fused silica, polished to a few nanometres and hung on silica fibres: a mirror that does nothing but follow spacetime.
item.theoreticalsciences.theodolite_lens: A sighting lens on a graduated circle: two angles and one measured baseline, and every distance follows.
item.theoreticalsciences.theoretical_dos: The theories of the middle ages of your research. Feeds a Research Nexus.
item.theoreticalsciences.theoretical_not: One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.

item.theoreticalsciences.thorium_232_pel: Three times as common as uranium, and not fissile itself - but a neutron makes it uranium-233, which is.

item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_alloy_scr: Metal pulled thin by tides stronger than its bonds.
item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_horror_sp: Calls a Tidal Horror into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_stretcher: A creature of the tide near a compact mass, where feet are pulled harder than head. It draws everything near it out long and thin, like spaghetti.
item.theoreticalsciences.time_dilated_sa: A crystal grown deep in a gravity well. By its own clock it took longer to form than the outside world saw.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_boa: A board whose traces are protected by topology.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_bou: A boule doped with topological insulator. Its surface conducts; its interior never will.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_def: A knot in a broken symmetry: the field could not agree which vacuum to fall into, so it kept both - and the seam between them cannot untie.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_die: A die of topologically protected logic.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_ins: Insulating bulk, conducting surface - protected by topology.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_log: Braided anyons on a wafer - errors cannot touch them.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_pro: Tier III processor. Fault-tolerant by geometry.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_waf: A wafer whose edges carry current without resistance.
item.theoreticalsciences.topos.lore: A universe of mathematics with its own internal logic. Change the topos and you change what is true.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendence_c: A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_me: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_pl: 1,000 mB of Transcendent Plasma - a liquid, at 100,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendental_: π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Mined in the Platonic Realm, or extracted from axiom stone in an Analytic Continuator.
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.
item.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_lat: Threaded with ℵ₀ turns. It never quite finishes screwing in, and it never comes loose.
item.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_pro: Tier VII processor. Finishes infinitely many operations in finite time.
item.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_wea: A weave with more threads than any finite count. Aleph-one and Absolute Infinity are stitched on it.
item.theoreticalsciences.transit_light_c: A star's brightness, dipping for a few hours as a planet crosses in front of it. The depth gives the planet's size.
item.theoreticalsciences.treads_of_infin: Every step lands. None of them fall.
item.theoreticalsciences.tree_simulacrum: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.
item.theoreticalsciences.tritium_cell.lo: 1,000 mB of Tritium - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
item.theoreticalsciences.true_vacuum_see: A bubble of the deeper vacuum, held below its critical radius. Let it grow and it expands at the speed of light, forever.
item.theoreticalsciences.turbomolecular_: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand rpm, batting gas molecules out of the beamline one at a time.
item.theoreticalsciences.turing_morphoge: Two chemicals, one fast and one slow, that paint stripes and spots by themselves.
item.theoreticalsciences.unbihexium_ingo: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long.
item.theoreticalsciences.undecidable_ker: A program no other program can predict: whether it halts is true or false, and provably unprovable. It runs on anyway.

item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_gravito: A quantum of gravity that has not yet decided to exist.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_monopol: A magnet with one pole. The vacuum only lends these briefly.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_pair_sp: Calls a Virtual Pair into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Light that never left anything and will never arrive.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_quark.l: A quark borrowed from the vacuum. It wants to go back.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_essence.lo: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_sh: A fragment of the scaffolding between branes.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_si: 32,768 void lattice shard, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_wraith_spa: Calls a Void Wraith into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item.theoreticalsciences.warm_helium_cel: 1,000 mB of Warm Helium - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item.theoreticalsciences.wave_packet.lor: A particle, written as a sum of waves - localised, but never exactly.
item.theoreticalsciences.wavefunction.lo: Everything a particle could be, written down at once.
item.theoreticalsciences.waveguide.lore: A rectangular copper pipe that carries microwaves the way a pipe carries water - no wave longer than twice its width gets through.
item.theoreticalsciences.well_ordering_c: Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy.

item.theoreticalsciences.white_dwarf_cor: A star's carbon heart, the size of a planet and held up only by electron degeneracy.
item.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_frag: A time-reversed horizon. Nothing can enter.

item.theoreticalsciences.zeolite_catalys: A crystal full of molecule-sized pores; reactions that fit inside go faster.

proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.rule: Six numbers hang on the wall. Make a seventh that no list could contain. Cantor needed only one line to do it.
proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.steps:
HOW TO ESCAPE
1. On the wall, lit lamps are 1 and dark lamps are 0. Each row is one number.
2. The gold [digits] run down the diagonal: digit 1 of Number 1, digit 2 of Number 2 ... digit 6 of Number 6.
3. Flip your switches below so each of YOUR digits is the OPPOSITE of the gold digit in the same column.
4. Touch the pedestal. Your number now differs from every number on the wall, so it cannot be on the list.

research.theoreticalsciences.abiogenesis: Where chemistry becomes life. Unlocks the Abiogenesis Crucible and the Spark of Life.
research.theoreticalsciences.abstract_al: Quaternions, octonions and spinors: number systems that give up commutativity, then associativity.
research.theoreticalsciences.accelerator: Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.
research.theoreticalsciences.accretion_p: Matter falling onto a compact object turns its gravity into light - up to a third of its rest energy for a spinning black hole, fifty times better than fusion. The brightest things in the universe are lit this way. Unlocks the Accretion Disk Reactor.
research.theoreticalsciences.ads_cft.des: A theory of gravity in a curved space and a quantum field theory on its boundary, without gravity, are the same theory in two languages. The universe as a hologram, made exact.
research.theoreticalsciences.alcubierre_: General relativity allows a bubble of flat space to be carried faster than light - if its wall is made of negative energy. Unlocks the Warp Field Forge.
research.theoreticalsciences.analog_grav: A fluid flowing faster than its own sound has a horizon for sound, and the mathematics of sound on it is the mathematics of light near a black hole - Hawking radiation included. Unlocks the Analog Black Hole.
research.theoreticalsciences.annihilatio: Matter plus antimatter equals pure energy. Dilithium keeps it from equalling a crater.
research.theoreticalsciences.anomalous_l: An anomaly in physics is a law that holds classically but fails in the quantum world: a conserved charge that quietly is not. Where a defect touches ordinary space, such failures leak out - local violations the rest of physics must absorb. Unlocks the Local Law Violation.
research.theoreticalsciences.anomalous_p: Every science has its anomalies: effects that the laws we know cannot explain, systems that copy themselves and refuse to die. Containment failures leave them lying around. Study them properly - how they arise, spread, interact with the normal world, and how they can finally be explained. Unlocks the Anomaly Containment Ward and Contained Anomaly Specimens.
research.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_res: The last step is not destruction but understanding. An anomaly measured completely - how it scales, where it breaks the law and by exactly how much - can be renormalised: absorbed into a deeper law that explains it. It was never abnormal, only unexplained. Unlocks the Resolved Anomaly.
research.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_sca: What can an anomaly do, and how big can it get? Catalogue them, and their sizes - tumours, outbreaks, avalanches, ruptures - follow power laws: most are tiny, a few are vast, and the mean is set by the exponent. Unlocks the Anomaly Catalogue.
research.theoreticalsciences.antiatom_ch: An antiproton and a positron make antihydrogen - with exactly the same spectrum as hydrogen. Unlocks the Antiproton Decelerator.
research.theoreticalsciences.artificial_: Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.
research.theoreticalsciences.assembly_li: Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.
research.theoreticalsciences.asymptotic_: Gravity's coupling, followed to ever shorter distances, may settle onto a fixed point instead of blowing up - and then general relativity is a complete quantum theory as it stands.
research.theoreticalsciences.autocatalys: A reaction whose product speeds up its own making grows exponentially and can oscillate, flare and spread as a wave. A prion does it with shape alone: a misfolded protein that refolds the healthy ones it touches. Unlocks Autocatalytic Broth and the Prion Lattice.
research.theoreticalsciences.axiom_theor: Beneath the source code of reality lie its axioms - and axioms can be distilled, edited and broken. Unlocks the Axiom Distiller.
research.theoreticalsciences.baryon_asym: For every billion antibaryons in the early universe there were a billion and one baryons. We are the one. Unlocks the Baryogenesis Seed.
research.theoreticalsciences.bayesian_in: Belief is a probability, and evidence should change it by a fixed rule: how likely the evidence was if you are right, against how likely it was anyway. Unlocks the Bayesian Analyzer and the Prior and Posterior Tablets.
research.theoreticalsciences.beyond_the_: With the Proof of Everything, the Omnilex Engine can be pushed past the possible - into the Transcendental.
research.theoreticalsciences.big_bang_co: Everything we see was once hotter and denser than the inside of any star, and has been expanding and cooling ever since. The Friedmann equations of general relativity say how fast: by what fills the universe and how it is curved. The first study of the Origin.
research.theoreticalsciences.big_crunch: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce
Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity - at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion. Unlocks the Bounce Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.big_rip.des: If dark energy is phantom - w below -1 - its density grows as space expands. Clusters, then galaxies, then stars and planets, then atoms are torn apart, all in a finite time. Unlocks the Phantom Energy Cell.
research.theoreticalsciences.binary_merg: Two compact stars in orbit radiate gravitational waves, spiral in, and merge in a final whoop of rising pitch. Their chirp mass sets how fast. Unlocks gravitational-wave echoes - and an answer from the Frontier.
research.theoreticalsciences.black_hole_: After the protons, only black holes are left, slowly radiating. A black hole of a solar mass needs 10^67 years to evaporate, a supermassive one 10^100 - and then it ends in a flash. Unlocks the Last Flash of a Black Hole.
What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

A black hole has a temperature, so it has an entropy - and that entropy is its horizon's area in Planck units, divided by four. The most information any region can hold is set by its surface, not its volume.
research.theoreticalsciences.brane_cosmo: Our universe is a membrane floating in the Bulk. The Brane Shifter can take you there.
research.theoreticalsciences.brownian_mo: Pollen grains in water never keep still. In 1905 Einstein showed why - molecules too small to see, striking them at random - and how far they wander says how big the molecules are. Perrin watched, and atoms were real. Unlocks the Brownian Microscope.
research.theoreticalsciences.calculus.de: Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.
research.theoreticalsciences.cartography: A map is a projection: a round planet drawn on a flat sheet, and every projection trades one truth for another. The first study of the Earth sciences. Unlocks the Survey Map.
research.theoreticalsciences.casimir_eff: Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.
research.theoreticalsciences.category_th: Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.
research.theoreticalsciences.causal_set_: Spacetime as a set of events and nothing else but which can affect which. Scatter them at random, and a manifold appears: order plus number gives geometry.
research.theoreticalsciences.causality_v: Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.
research.theoreticalsciences.chemical_bo: Atoms share electrons because a shared wavefunction has lower energy. Unlocks the Chemical Reactor.
research.theoreticalsciences.chronodynam: If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.
research.theoreticalsciences.climatology: What the air holds decides how much of the Sun's heat the world keeps: carbon dioxide traps it, aerosols send it back. Unlocks the Climate Engine.
research.theoreticalsciences.clonal_evol: A tumour is a population, and populations evolve. Every treatment selects the few cells that happen to resist it; they inherit the tumour. Drug resistance is not learned but chosen - by the treatment itself. Unlocks the Resistant Clone Colony.
research.theoreticalsciences.combinatori: Counting without listing: how many orders, how many choices, how fast the numbers grow - so fast that their logarithm is the only way to hold them. Unlocks the Quantum Random Number Chip.
research.theoreticalsciences.compact_sta: Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.
research.theoreticalsciences.compactific: Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.
research.theoreticalsciences.complex_ana: Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.
research.theoreticalsciences.component_t: Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.
research.theoreticalsciences.conceptual_: Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.
research.theoreticalsciences.conformal_c: At the end of time only massless things remain, and massless things cannot tell an infinite distance from a finite one. Rescale the dead universe and its infinite future becomes the Big Bang of the next aeon. Where Finality ends, Origin begins: make a Universe Seed from the end of a universe.
research.theoreticalsciences.conquered_a: You understood. It let you go.
research.theoreticalsciences.containment: To study an anomaly you must keep it alive; to keep the world safe you must keep it from spreading. Quarantine is the art of clearing it just faster than it copies itself - R below 1, and not much below. Unlocks the Quarantine Field Matrix.
research.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_esch: How does a universe end? Its fate is written in what fills it: matter decelerates the expansion, dark energy accelerates it, and the equation of state w decides whether it freezes, rips or collapses. The first study of Finality.
research.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_infl: Why is the universe so flat, so smooth, and the same in every direction - even regions that could never have touched? Because a scalar field, the inflaton, made space grow by e sixty times over in 10^-32 seconds. Unlocks the Inflation Chamber and Inflaton Condensate.
On the largest scales the galaxies are not scattered evenly: they lie along filaments and sheets round enormous voids, the shape gravity has pulled the dark matter into since the Big Bang. Unlocks the cosmic web simulation.
research.theoreticalsciences.cosmogenesi: False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.
research.theoreticalsciences.cpt_symmetr: Reverse charge, parity and time together and the laws of physics do not change. Somewhere, then, there is a universe of antimatter. Unlocks the CPT Mirror and the Penning Harness.
Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.
research.theoreticalsciences.crystal_gro: Every transistor, laser and lens crystal starts as a seed dipped in its own melt. How fast it is drawn out decides what defects and impurities it keeps. Unlocks the Crystal Growth Furnace and its boules.
research.theoreticalsciences.crystallogr: A crystal is one pattern of atoms repeated in every direction. X-rays are short enough to be scattered by its planes, and the angles at which they reinforce give the spacing between them. Unlocks the X-ray Diffractometer and the Laue Pattern.
research.theoreticalsciences.cyclotron_p: A charge in a magnetic field circles at a frequency that does not depend on its speed. Kick it at that frequency and it spirals out, faster every turn - until relativity puts it out of step. Unlocks the Cyclotron.
research.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy: The energy of empty space itself, pushing galaxies apart.
research.theoreticalsciences.dark_sector: Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.
research.theoreticalsciences.decay_chain: Uranium becomes thorium, then radium, then radon, then polonium and at last lead - fourteen steps, each with its own half-life. Wait long enough and every step runs as fast as the slowest feeds it. Unlocks Radiogenic Lead and Lead Shielding.
research.theoreticalsciences.deep_drilli: The deepest hole ever drilled went down 12 km and met rock at 180 °C, softer than expected and full of water. Drilling deep is a fight with heat and pressure. Unlocks the Deep Drilling Rig.
research.theoreticalsciences.directed_ev: A million generations in a minute, if time runs fast enough. Unlocks the Evolution Engine and telomerase.
research.theoreticalsciences.distributio: Add up enough small independent chances and their total always spreads into the same bell-shaped curve, whatever the chances were. Unlocks the Normal Distribution Crystal.
research.theoreticalsciences.dyson_spher: Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.
research.theoreticalsciences.electrochem: Chemistry is electrons moving; push them with a voltage. Unlocks the Electrolytic Cell.
research.theoreticalsciences.electrodyna: Maxwell's four equations: charges make electric fields, there are no magnetic charges, changing fields make each other - and so a wave of field can carry itself across empty space, at exactly the speed of light. Unlocks waveguides, Faraday cage mesh, mu-metal and the Hypervelocity Impact Forge.
research.theoreticalsciences.electromagn: A changing magnetic field drives a current. Spin a coil in a field and you have a generator; laminate the iron core and you stop it heating itself. Unlocks Magnetite and Electrical Steel Laminations.
research.theoreticalsciences.entangled_l: Two particles, one state - and so one channel. Unlocks Entangled Relays, Transceivers and the Entanglement Tuner.
research.theoreticalsciences.epidemic_dy: Between hosts, an infection is a reproduction number. Above R = 1 it spreads through a population; below it, it dies out - a phase transition, the same as water freezing or a fluid percolating through porous rock. Unlocks the Contagion Network Map.
research.theoreticalsciences.equivalence: Drop a hammer and a feather on the Moon and they land together. Gravity pulls everything with the same acceleration, so in free fall gravity vanishes - Einstein's happiest thought. Unlocks the Proof Mass.
research.theoreticalsciences.er_epr.desc: Maldacena and Susskind's conjecture: two entangled particles are joined by a wormhole, too small to pass through. Entanglement is geometry. Unlocks the ER=EPR Weaver.
research.theoreticalsciences.ergodic_the: A system that, given time, passes through every state open to it: averaging over time is then the same as averaging over all states. Unlocks the Markov Chain Refinery and the Ergodic Mixer Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.exoplanetol: Most stars have planets. Watch a star's light dip as one crosses in front of it, and the dip gives its size; its spectrum through the planet's air gives what it is made of. Unlocks transit photometry and the assay of exoplanet cores.
research.theoreticalsciences.exotic_chem: Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.
research.theoreticalsciences.extreme_val: The largest of many random draws follows its own law - and the rarest events are less rare than a bell curve says. Black swans happen.
research.theoreticalsciences.extremophil: Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.
research.theoreticalsciences.femtoengine: Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.
research.theoreticalsciences.ferromagnet: In iron, the spins of neighbouring atoms line up of their own accord - until heat shakes them apart above a critical temperature. Unlocks the Ferrite Magnet.
research.theoreticalsciences.field_engin: Gravity, dimension, time and the vacuum are all fields - and fields can be projected. Unlocks the Field Projectors, the Graviton Harness and the Chronal Anchor.
research.theoreticalsciences.formal_logi: Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.
research.theoreticalsciences.fractional_: High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.
research.theoreticalsciences.frame_dragg: A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope in orbit round the Earth turns, by forty milliarcseconds a year, for no other reason. Unlocks the Lense-Thirring Vortex Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.fusion_igni: Deuterium and tritium fuse into helium and a neutron, giving 17.6 MeV - if they are hot enough, dense enough, and held long enough. Unlocks the Tokamak, heavy water, deuterium and tritium breeding.
research.theoreticalsciences.galactic_dy: Map how fast the Galaxy's hydrogen turns at each distance from its centre and the stars alone cannot hold it together: something unseen outweighs them several times over. Unlocks the long galactic survey.
research.theoreticalsciences.gamma_ray_b: For a few seconds, the brightest light in the Universe: a jet from a newborn black hole at nearly the speed of light, beamed straight at us. Unlocks the Burst Observatory.
research.theoreticalsciences.general_int: A mind that can learn anything.
research.theoreticalsciences.general_rel: Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.
research.theoreticalsciences.genomics.de: Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.
research.theoreticalsciences.geodesics.d: In curved spacetime a falling body takes the straightest path there is - a geodesic. Gravity is not a force; it is the shape of the road. Unlocks the Geodesic Compass.
research.theoreticalsciences.geodesy.des: Measure one baseline and two angles and every other distance follows - that is how countries were mapped, triangle by triangle. Geodesy measures the planet itself. Unlocks the Theodolite Lens, the Geoid Model and the Geodetic Surveyor.
research.theoreticalsciences.geometric_o: A lens bends light by the difference in its two curvatures, times how much more slowly light runs in it. Grind the curvatures, polish the error away, and you have an instrument. Unlocks the Optical Workshop and its lenses, plates and gratings.
research.theoreticalsciences.geometric_t: Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.
research.theoreticalsciences.geomorpholo: Landforms are a record: rivers carry grains, the grains settle, and the speed at which they settle sorts sand from silt from clay. Unlocks the Sediment Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.grand_unifi: At high enough energy, three forces become one.
research.theoreticalsciences.gravitation: Light follows geodesics too: a mass bends the light passing it, twice as much as Newton would say, and a mass exactly between you and a star turns it into a ring. Unlocks the Lensing Concentrator.

Light climbing out of a gravity well loses energy, so its frequency falls: clocks below run slow seen from above. In 1959 Pound and Rebka measured it up a 22.5-metre tower. Unlocks the Pound-Rebka Tower and the Cobalt-57 Source.
A clock lower in a gravity well ticks slower than one above it. Satellite navigation has to correct for it every day, or it would drift kilometres. Unlocks the Atomic Clock.

Masses that accelerate send ripples through spacetime itself, stretching and squeezing everything they cross. The strongest reach us from merging black holes - as a strain of one part in 10²¹. Unlocks the Laser Interferometer and its Test Masses.
research.theoreticalsciences.hawking_rad: Near a horizon the same happens without anyone accelerating: a black hole glows, at a temperature inversely proportional to its mass, and slowly evaporates. Unlocks the Micro Black Hole Evaporator.
The likeliest end of all: endless expansion to maximum entropy. Stars burn out, protons decay, black holes evaporate, and an empty de Sitter space is left, glowing at the temperature of its own horizon. Unlocks the Entropy Horizon.
research.theoreticalsciences.holographic: Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.
research.theoreticalsciences.horizon_sim: A black hole is the densest possible computer. Feed it a star and it will simulate one. Unlocks the Eye of the Event Horizon.
research.theoreticalsciences.hydrology.d: Water moves through rock as through a sponge, slowly: Darcy's law, flow = permeability × pressure gradient. Under the plains lie aquifers of rain that fell before the last ice age. Unlocks the Aquifer Pump.
research.theoreticalsciences.hyperdimens: Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.
The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.
research.theoreticalsciences.immune_evas: To survive, an anomaly must escape everything built to remove it: hide its markers from the immune system, switch telomerase back on and forget how to age, grow its own blood vessels, and finally leave - slip into the blood and seed itself somewhere new. Unlocks the Immortal Cell Line and the Metastatic Spore.
research.theoreticalsciences.incompleten: Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.
research.theoreticalsciences.information: If a black hole evaporates into thermal radiation, whatever fell in is lost - and quantum mechanics forbids that. Something must give. Unlocks the Page Curve Analyzer.
research.theoreticalsciences.interstella: Between the stars is not nothing: a few atoms in every cubic centimetre, cold molecular clouds where stars are born, hot ionised bubbles blown by the ones that died, and dust through all of it. Unlocks the Interstellar Scoop.
research.theoreticalsciences.invasion_fr: No anomaly grows alone. It recruits blood vessels and stroma, signals to the cells around it, and invades as a travelling front whose speed is set by how fast it grows and how far it diffuses - the same mathematics as a cellular automaton spreading on a grid. Unlocks the Tumour Microenvironment Organoid.
research.theoreticalsciences.island_of_s: Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.
research.theoreticalsciences.isotope_sep: Isotopes of one element are chemically the same; only their mass differs, by about one per cent for uranium. Spin them fast enough and that is enough to sort them, a little at a time. Unlocks the Gas Centrifuge Cascade, Yellowcake and Fluorspar.
research.theoreticalsciences.kilonovae.d: When two neutron stars merge, a few hundredths of a solar mass of neutron-rich matter is flung out, and in a second it captures neutrons up to gold and platinum. Its radioactive glow fades over days.
research.theoreticalsciences.laser_physi: An excited atom struck by a photon of the right colour gives off a second, identical one. Pump a crystal full of excited atoms between two mirrors and the light builds on itself: one colour, one direction, in step. Unlocks the Laser Rod, Laser Head and Faraday Isolator.
research.theoreticalsciences.leptogenesi: Matter and antimatter should have annihilated perfectly. They did not: heavy neutrinos decayed out of equilibrium, unequally to leptons and antileptons, and sphalerons turned the excess into baryons - one in a billion. Unlocks the Baryon Asymmetry Crystal.
research.theoreticalsciences.loop_quantu: Quantise geometry itself: areas and volumes come in discrete steps, carried by a spin network. Space is woven, not continuous. Unlocks the Spin Network Loom.
research.theoreticalsciences.m_theory.de: Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.
research.theoreticalsciences.magnetars.d: A star's core collapses to a neutron star and its field is squeezed with it, flux conserved: a thousand times stronger than any magnet made on Earth, a billion times. Starquakes crack its crust.
research.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_co: A charged particle spirals round a field line and cannot leave it. Twist the lines into a torus and a plasma can be held off every wall. Unlocks the Pulsed Magnet Lab and the Tokamak's coils.
research.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_mo: Grand unified theories say magnetic charges must exist, made in the first instant - and Dirac showed that one would explain why every electric charge is a whole number of e. The Pulsed Magnet Lab can search for them in magnetar crust.
research.theoreticalsciences.magnetohydr: A conducting fluid in a magnetic field carries the field with it and pushes current through it: the physics of the Sun's surface, of the geodynamo, and of a generator with no moving parts. Unlocks the MHD Generator.
research.theoreticalsciences.magnetostat: A steady current makes a magnetic field that circles the wire and weakens with distance from it. The first study of electromagnetism. Unlocks the Gauss Meter.
research.theoreticalsciences.mantle_geod: The mantle is solid rock, and yet it flows: a centimetre a year, heated from below, cooled from above, turning over like a pot on a stove. Its minerals - ringwoodite, bridgmanite - only exist under its pressure.
research.theoreticalsciences.mass_manipu: Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.
research.theoreticalsciences.matrioshka_: Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.
research.theoreticalsciences.measure_pro: In a universe that lasts forever, everything that can fluctuate into being does, infinitely often - even a lone brain that only thinks it remembers a world. How then to say what is likely? Unlocks the deliberate assembly of a Boltzmann Brain.
research.theoreticalsciences.metamateria: Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.
research.theoreticalsciences.metamorphis: Bury a rock and it changes without melting: its minerals regrow as the ones stable at the new pressure and temperature. Every boundary on that map has a slope set by how much the change gains in entropy and loses in volume. Unlocks the Tectonic Press.
research.theoreticalsciences.meteoritics: Stones fall from the sky: iron ones from the broken cores of small planets, stony ones that never melted at all since the planets formed. Look for their craters. Unlocks the assay of meteorites.
research.theoreticalsciences.mirror_meta: Metals that must never touch anything. Unlocks the Mirror Matter Foundry, anti-metals and the Mirror Alloy.
research.theoreticalsciences.molecular_b: Life is chemistry that copies itself. Unlocks the Bioreactor, Nutrient Broth and the Gene Sampler.
research.theoreticalsciences.monte_carlo: When a sum is too hard to do, guess it at random - many times. The scatter of the guesses falls as one over the square root of how many; steer them well and it falls faster. Unlocks the Monte Carlo Engine.
research.theoreticalsciences.morphogenes: How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.
Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.
research.theoreticalsciences.nanochemist: Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.
research.theoreticalsciences.nanotechnol: Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.
research.theoreticalsciences.neurobiolog: Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.
research.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_ph: Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.
research.theoreticalsciences.neutron_int: A neutron is a wave too. Split it with a perfect crystal, let gravity pull on one path a little more than the other, and the waves no longer meet in step: gravity, measured on a single quantum particle. Unlocks the Neutron Interferometer and the Silicon Boule.
research.theoreticalsciences.nuclear_ast: Stars fuse by tunnelling: their protons are far too cold to touch, but quantum mechanics lets a few through the Coulomb barrier. The Gamow energy sets which ones.
research.theoreticalsciences.nuclear_bin: A nucleus weighs less than the protons and neutrons in it. The missing mass is the energy that binds them - millions of times more per atom than any chemical bond. The way into fission and fusion.
research.theoreticalsciences.nuclear_fis: A slow neutron splits a uranium-235 nucleus into two lighter ones, freeing 200 MeV and two or three new neutrons. If on average exactly one of them splits another nucleus, the reaction keeps itself going. Unlocks the Molten Salt Reactor.
research.theoreticalsciences.nuclear_iso: Some nuclei can sit in an excited state for years, held there by their spin. Hafnium-178m2 holds 2.4 MeV per nucleus for thirty-one years. Unlocks the Isomer Trigger.
research.theoreticalsciences.nucleosynth: Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.
research.theoreticalsciences.number_syst: Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.
research.theoreticalsciences.number_theo: Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.
research.theoreticalsciences.observation: Everything known about the sky came through a lens. A bigger mirror gathers more light and splits finer detail - up to the limit that the wave nature of light itself sets. Unlocks the Telescope Mirror Blank.
research.theoreticalsciences.omnilex.des: Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.
research.theoreticalsciences.oncogenesis: A cancer is not one mistake but several: an oncogene stuck on, a tumour suppressor like p53 lost, a checkpoint skipped - each a mutation that gives one cell an advantage over its neighbours. The hallmarks of cancer are what that cell has learned. Unlocks the Anomalous Strain Culture.
The radiation's entropy rises as a black hole evaporates, then - after the Page time - falls back to zero: the information comes out. Islands inside the horizon, counted as part of the radiation, make it turn over.
Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.
research.theoreticalsciences.paradox_eng: Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.
research.theoreticalsciences.particle_ph: Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.
research.theoreticalsciences.pathologica: Mathematics has its monsters too: curves continuous everywhere and smooth nowhere, sets with no size, systems so sensitive that they are deterministic and unpredictable at once, and questions no algorithm can decide. They were never errors - only the parts of the theory that had not been explained yet. Unlocks the Undecidable Kernel.
research.theoreticalsciences.penrose_pro: Energy can be stolen from a rotating black hole's ergosphere.
research.theoreticalsciences.planetary_g: Every rocky planet sorts itself the same way: iron sinks to a core, rock floats above as mantle and crust. Comparing their cores tells how planets form.
research.theoreticalsciences.plasma_meta: Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.
research.theoreticalsciences.plate_tecto: The crust is broken into plates that ride on the hot mantle beneath. Where they part, rock wells up; where they meet, one dives under the other. Unlocks the Core Drill - the first tool that cuts bedrock - and the way into the Planetary Interior.
research.theoreticalsciences.platonic_re: If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.
research.theoreticalsciences.pleroma.des: The fullness of everything: every fluid there is, poured together. Unlocks the Pleroma Confluence.
research.theoreticalsciences.poincare_re: A dead universe is not quite dead. In a finite system at equilibrium every state comes back, given time, and fluctuations out of equilibrium happen by pure chance - a star, a planet, a brain. Unlocks the Boltzmann Fluctuation.
research.theoreticalsciences.precision_l: Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.
research.theoreticalsciences.primordial_: For three minutes the whole universe was a fusion reactor. Neutrons froze out at one in six, decayed a little, and were swept into helium-4: a quarter of all matter, as measured. Unlocks Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash.
research.theoreticalsciences.probability: Chance has rules. Count the ways an outcome can happen, divide by all the ways anything can, and the result is exact even when every single trial is not. Unlocks the Dice Set.
research.theoreticalsciences.protein_fol: A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.
research.theoreticalsciences.proton_deca: Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.
research.theoreticalsciences.psionics.de: Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_bio: Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_che: Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_cos: Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe. Unlocks the No-Boundary Seed.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_ent: Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_fie: Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_foa: Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_fou: Everything is a wave until it is measured. Catalogue phenomena with the Spectral Analyzer to begin.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_gra: Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_hal: Electrons in a sheet at low temperature and strong field fill Landau levels; the Hall resistance locks onto plateaus at h/(νe²), exact to a part in a billion - because it counts a topological invariant. Unlocks Hall Bar Chips.
research.theoreticalsciences.radio_astro: Cold hydrogen, invisible to any telescope, glows at 21 centimetres; dead stars spinning hundreds of times a second pulse in radio. A dish and a cold receiver hear them through cloud and daylight. Unlocks the Radio Telescope and the Cryogenic Receiver.
research.theoreticalsciences.radioactivi: Some nuclei are unstable and fall apart on their own, at random, but at a rate fixed for each kind. Half of any sample is gone after its half-life, whatever you do to it. Unlocks Radium Salt, the Geiger Tube and Counter, and the Prussian Blue Tablet.
research.theoreticalsciences.radiochemis: Chemistry done by following radioactivity: a few atoms of a new element are found because they glow. Radium gives off a gas, radon, that decays in days. Unlocks the Decay Chamber.
research.theoreticalsciences.real_analys: Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.
research.theoreticalsciences.reality_bre: Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.
research.theoreticalsciences.reheating.d: Inflation leaves space empty and cold. When the inflaton reaches the bottom of its potential it oscillates and decays, and its energy becomes a hot plasma of every particle there is: the hot Big Bang begins here. Unlocks Reheating Plasma.
research.theoreticalsciences.remote_sens: A telescope turned round: from orbit, in visible light and infrared and radar, the whole ground at once. Unlocks the Survey Satellite.
research.theoreticalsciences.research_sy: Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.
research.theoreticalsciences.resonant_ci: A capacitor and a coil pass energy back and forth, electric then magnetic, at one frequency of their own. Two such circuits in tune trade it between them - and one can step the voltage up enormously. Unlocks the Tesla Coil.
Earthquakes send two kinds of wave through rock: fast pressure waves and slower shear waves. Time the gap between them and you know how far away the source is; time it at three stations and you know where. Unlocks the Seismograph.
research.theoreticalsciences.self_replic: A program that prints itself, a machine that builds itself from a description of itself, a virus, a rumour: every replicator holds a copy of its own instructions. Whether its lineage survives is a branching process - it dies out unless each copy makes more than one more. Unlocks the Quine Replicator.
research.theoreticalsciences.semiclassic: Quantum fields on curved spacetime: what can be said with gravity still classical and everything else quantum. Its two tested predictions - gravity on a quantum wave, and a horizon's glow - point past themselves, to spacetime that is quantum too. Unlocks causal dynamical triangulations in the Monte Carlo Engine.
Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.
research.theoreticalsciences.simulation_: If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.
research.theoreticalsciences.singularity: Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.
research.theoreticalsciences.special_rel: The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.
research.theoreticalsciences.spectroscop: Split light by colour and its spectrum tells you what made it: how hot, and which elements, by the dark and bright lines each one leaves. Unlocks the Spectrograph and Spectral Plates.
research.theoreticalsciences.standard_mo: Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.
research.theoreticalsciences.statistical: Temperature, pressure and entropy are averages over states too many to count: each weighted by e^(−E/kT). Sum the weights and the partition function holds every property of the system.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_ast: A star's colour gives its surface temperature, and its brightness and temperature together give its size: a star radiates σT⁴ from every square metre. The Sun is the star close enough to use. Unlocks the Solar Furnace and deep-sky exposures.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_eng: Ignite a captive star from white-hole ejecta.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_evo: Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_tra: Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.
research.theoreticalsciences.stochastic_: Chance that unfolds in time: a walk with random steps, a clock with random ticks, a chain whose next state depends only on this one. Unlocks Markov Chain Links, Poisson Clocks and Brownian Suspension.
research.theoreticalsciences.string_theo: Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.
research.theoreticalsciences.superacid_c: Acids a million million times stronger than sulfuric - strong enough to protonate almost anything.
research.theoreticalsciences.superconduc: Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.
research.theoreticalsciences.superintell: A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.
research.theoreticalsciences.supersymmet: Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.
research.theoreticalsciences.supramolecu: Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.
research.theoreticalsciences.symbiosis_p: Two populations that share a world either compete, prey, or help. A parasite and a symbiont can be the same organism with one interaction coefficient flipped - mitochondria were invaders once. The boundary between anomaly and normality is a sign. Unlocks the Symbiont Culture.
research.theoreticalsciences.synthetic_b: Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.
Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.
research.theoreticalsciences.targeted_th: Kill the anomaly, spare the normal: CRISPR-written triggers that make only anomalous cells accept apoptosis, CAR-T cells taught to hunt one marker, and dose split into fractions the normal tissue can repair between. Unlocks the Anomaly Resolution Engine, the Apoptosis Trigger and CAR-T Cell Culture.
research.theoreticalsciences.telescope_o: A telescope is a light bucket: its mirror gathers as much more light than your eye as its area is larger, so it records stars hundreds of times fainter. What it cannot beat is the air above it. Unlocks the Reflecting Telescope and the Photographic Plate.
research.theoreticalsciences.temporal_me: The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.
research.theoreticalsciences.the_rekindl: The Transcendental exists again, and the Core with it - now able to forge what even it could not simply make.
research.theoreticalsciences.the_sunderi: You told Omnipotence to stop, and it did. From its shards: Omnipotence Dust, the Apeiron Ingot, the Pleroma Crystal, Logos Thread - and the Pleroma Reconstitutor.
research.theoreticalsciences.theory_of_e: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.
research.theoreticalsciences.thermodynam: Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.
research.theoreticalsciences.tidal_physi: Gravity pulls harder on your near side than your far side. Near a small black hole the difference tears anything apart lengthwise - spaghettification.
research.theoreticalsciences.topological: When a field cools and must choose between equal vacua, distant regions choose differently - and where they meet, the old symmetry is trapped in a wall, a string or a knot that cannot be smoothed away. Pockets of false vacuum survive the same way. Unlocks the Topological Defect Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.topology.de: Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.
research.theoreticalsciences.transfinite: Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.
Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.
research.theoreticalsciences.transuranic: Beyond uranium every element is made: a nucleus is fed neutrons until it beta-decays up the table - plutonium, americium, curium, californium. Unlocks Californium-252.
research.theoreticalsciences.traversable: Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.
research.theoreticalsciences.unruh_effec: Empty space is empty only for an observer who is not accelerating. Accelerate, and the vacuum fills with a warm glow - at a temperature proportional to the acceleration. Unlocks the Unruh Accelerator.
research.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_deca: If our vacuum is only metastable, a bubble of the true vacuum may nucleate somewhere, someday. Its wall sweeps outwards at nearly the speed of light, and inside it the laws of physics are different. There would be no warning. Unlocks the True Vacuum Seed.
research.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_ener: Store energy in the difference between two vacua. Unlocks the Energy Cells.
research.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_stab: What could stop a universe from starting at all? A vacuum energy a little larger and it would fly apart before stars formed; a Higgs coupling a little smaller and the vacuum would be unstable. Ours sits, by measurement, at the edge: metastable. Unlocks the Metastable Vacuum Lattice.
research.theoreticalsciences.white_holes: The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.
research.theoreticalsciences.xenobiology: Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

transit.theoreticalsciences.accretion_fr: Starlight presses on the sail. The stars crowd ahead, and something dark waits among them.
The sail turns for home. The black hole shrinks behind you to a point.
transit.theoreticalsciences.antiverse.fl: Charge, parity and time reversed. Touch nothing you brought with you.
Through the mirror again, back into a universe made of matter.
transit.theoreticalsciences.black_hole_i: Past the event horizon, every road leads to the centre.
Climbing out of a black hole. This should be impossible.
transit.theoreticalsciences.hyperdimensi: More directions than you have names for. The World Tree waits above the Ocean of Law.
The extra dimensions fold away. Three will have to do.
transit.theoreticalsciences.living_proof: Inside Alpha Omega's mind, every step must follow from the last.
Q.E.D. The proof lets you go.
transit.theoreticalsciences.planetary_in: Crust, mantle, and below: the rock grows hotter with every kilometre.
The layers fall away beneath you. Cool rock, then daylight.
transit.theoreticalsciences.platonic_rea: Every shadow on the cave wall gives way to its perfect form.
Back among the shadows. The forms stay true without you.
transit.theoreticalsciences.quantum_foam: Shrinking past the Planck length, where space itself boils.
The bubbles shrink to nothing as you grow back into the world.
transit.theoreticalsciences.the_bulk.fla: Our brane peels away. Between the membranes, gravity alone can follow you.
The membranes close in. You settle back onto our own brane.
transit.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_: Remove the middle third. Repeat forever. Keep counting past infinity.
Back to finite numbers, where every count comes to an end.
transit.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_i: Time runs backwards here: nothing may enter, everything is thrown out.
Flung out of the white hole and back into ordinary time.
